    "summary":"University of Cambridge astrophysics student Stephen Hawking begins a relationship with literature student Jane Wilde. Although Stephen is intelligent, his friends and professors are concerned about his lack of a thesis topic. After he and his professor Dennis Sciama attend a lecture on black holes, Stephen speculates that black holes may have been part of the creation of the universe, and decides to write his thesis on them. However, Stephen's muscles begin to fail, giving him decreasing coordination with his body. He learns he has motor neuron disease, which will eventually leave him unable to move, swallow, and even breathe. There are no treatments, and he has approximately two years to live. The doctor assures Stephen that his brain will not be affected, so his thoughts and intelligence will remain intact, but eventually, he will be unable to communicate them. As Stephen becomes reclusive, focusing on his work, Jane confesses she loves him. She tells his father she intends to stay with Stephen even as his condition worsens. They marry and have their first son, Robert. Stephen presents his thesis to the examination board, arguing that a black hole created the universe in a Big Bang, that it will emit heat, and end in a Big Crunch. He begins using a wheelchair after his walking ability deteriorates. After the Hawkings have their daughter Lucy, Stephen develops a theory about the visibility of black holes and becomes a world-renowned physicist. Jane, focusing on the children as well as Stephen's health and increasing fame, is unable to work on her own thesis and becomes frustrated. Stephen tells her he will understand if she needs help. She joins a church choir, where she meets widower Jonathan and they become close friends. She employs him as a piano teacher for Robert, and Jonathan befriends the entire family, helping Stephen with his illness, supporting Jane, and playing with the children. When Jane gives birth to another son, Timothy, Stephen's mother asks Jane if the baby is Jonathan's, which she denies. Jonathan is appalled, but when he and Jane are alone, they admit their feelings for one another. He distances himself from the family, but Stephen tells him Jane needs him. While attending an opera performance in Bordeaux, Stephen is taken ill and rushed to a hospital. The doctor informs Jane that he has pneumonia, and that he needs a tracheotomy to survive, but it will leave him mute. She agrees to the surgery. Stephen learns to use a spelling board, and uses it to communicate with Elaine, his new nurse. He receives a computer with a built-in voice synthesizer, and uses it to write a book, A Brief History of Time (1988), which becomes an international best-seller. Stephen tells Jane he has been invited to the United States to accept an award and will be taking Elaine with him. Jane faces the realization that the marriage has not been working, telling him she "did her best", and they agree to divorce. Stephen goes to the lecture with Elaine, the two have fallen in love, and Jane and Jonathan reunite. At the lecture, Stephen sees a student drop a pen; he imagines getting up to return it, almost crying at the reminder of how his disease has affected him. He goes on to give a speech telling audiences to pursue their ambitions despite the harsh reality of life: "While there's life, there is hope". Stephen invites Jane to meet Queen Elizabeth II with him when being made a member of the Order of the Companions of Honour; they share a happy day together with their grandchildren. An extended closing series comprises select moments from the film; shown in reverse, back to the moment Stephen first saw Jane; the reversal is reminiscent of Stephen's research methodology of reversing time to understand the beginning of the universe. Later, Jane and Jonathan marry, and she completes her Doctor of Philosophy. She and Stephen remain close friends. Stephen declines a knighthood from the Queen and continues his research, with no plans to retire in the near future."

    <scene_description>The PILOT and CO - PILOT are surrounded by an array of dimly lit GAUGES and SWITCHES . Before the Co - Pilot is a RADAR SCREEN and an INFRA - RED DISPLAY TERMINAL on which the TWO HELICOPTERS appear as HEAT SOURCES .</scene_description>
    <character>PILOT NUMBER ONE</character>
    <dialogue>roger Bird Two, Two. Reconfirm insertion at Tango, Charlie, Delta One, zero, niner on the grid at zero, two, two, mark four by zero. Over.</dialogue>
    <character>PILOT NUMBER TWO</character>
    <parenthetical>( voice over . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Two, Two, leader. Roger your insert co - ord. Over.</dialogue>
    <character>PILOT NUMBER ONE</character>
    <dialogue>Leader to Bird Two Two. I bear two minutes to Landing Zone.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>The Pilot throws a SWITCH on the panel before him</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>INT. HELICOPTER - NIGHT</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>A BLUE LIGHT appears on the forward bulkhead . Schaefer is speaking over a RADIO TELEPHONE . The Co - Pilot turns and hands him a clipboard . Schaefer reads , notes his approval and hands it back .</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. HELICOPTER - NIGHT</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Flares up into position over the jungle and hovers , as the SUPPORT HELICOPTER holds in a protective position above .</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>INT. HELICOPTER - NIGHT</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Dillon seems comfortable with the men , showing Ramirez a battered CIGARETTE LIGHTER from a famed commando unit from the past . But his ingratiating demeanor is not impressing Mac , who regards Dillon with the cold suspicion reserved for an outsider . Mac looks up at Blain , his eyes narrowing . Blain 's massive jaws roll as he masticates the chew . He pauses , eyes moving downward , spotting his target . He hocks a thick , vile stream of TOBACCO JUICE directly between Dillon 's legs and onto the floor , a gelatinous skein lacing across the toe of one boot . Dillon looks up , his face goes cold and menacing .</scene_description>
    <character>DILLON</character>
    <parenthetical>( icy . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Man, that's a real bad habit you've got.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Dillon turns back to Ramirez , ignoring Mac and Blain , who continues to stare at him . Mac looks across at Blain , wide grins breaking across their huge faces . Cradled in Blain 's arms , as if it were a part of his body , is a large , CANVAS - COVERED BUNDLE . Blain looks down at his bundle , almost affectionately . The PILOT 's VOICE breaks in over Schaefer 's headset .</scene_description>
    <character>PILOT NUMBER ONE</character>
    <parenthetical>( voice over . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>LZ comin' up in 30 seconds. Stand by the rappel lines.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Looking up , Schaefer gives a hand signal to the nearest man who nods and in return , passes the signal down the line . Ramirez and Blain pick up heavy , METAL CONICAL DEVICES , attached to canvas bags filled with rope .</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. HELICOPTER - NIGHT</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>From the open doors the RAPPELLING LINES hurtle into space , CRASHING through the double canopy of the trees and to the jungle floor below .</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>INT. HELICOPTER - NIGHT</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>The blue light changes to GREEN . Schaefer nods . RAPPELLING DEVICES SNAP into place . Gloved hands grab onto rope . Combat boots move into position .</scene_description>
    <character>DILLON</character>
    <parenthetical>( shouting to Schaefer . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>You do n't know how much I missed this, Dutch! Once you get this in your blood, you never get it out!</dialogue>
    <character>SCHAEFER</character>
    <dialogue>You never were all that smart. let's go!</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Schaefer signals . Men leap from the chopper .</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. JUNGLE - NIGHT</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>The man crash through the trees and are swallowed up by the darkness below . The helicopters depart , THUMPING their way into the night .</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. MOUNTAIN RIDGE - DAY (DAWN)</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>A light shower passes through the trees . The sky clears , REVEALING a lush and exotic foliage . Birds are beginning to SING but otherwise , all is SILENT . The dense growth seems impenetrable , but from a solid wall of undergrowth , a HAND appears and signals in a downward motion . As if by magic , the assault team materializes , quietly , cautiously . Schaefer makes another gesture and the team moves forward in perfect harmony in POINT - LOCK step , taking their cue from Ramirez , the pointman . Schaefer , highly focused and alert to every sound and movement , follows Ramirez , as if organically connected .</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. JUNGLE HILLSIDE - DAY</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Descending the steep mountain slope , the team encounters an even denser growth of jungle , at times moving by instinct , as they are often visually separated . At one point , Schaefer checks his COMPASS , flashing some hand signals to Ramirez , indicating a new direction . Ramirez nods and moves on , Schaefer signaling to the rest of the men .</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. JUNGLE CLEARING - DAY</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Blain , in a defensive position , sweeps the jungle slowly with his MP - 5 . He steps back and turns , checking , revealing in the b.g. the WRECKAGE OF A U.S. ARMY UH - 1H HELICOPTER , hanging upside down , twenty feet above the ground , entangled in vines in the heavy capony , badly damaged , rotors bent , its tail section blown away . A GRAPPLING HOOK is hurled from the ground , CLATTERING into the cargo hold , hooking the edge of the airframe .</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>INT. HELICOPTER - DAY</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Ramirez moves cautiously , searching for trip wires , using his knife to check the edges of the seats and door frames . Grimly he glances at the TWO BODIES slumped over the controls and then exits , snapping into and rappelling down the rope to the ground . He joins Schaefer standing in the f.g. . They look up , watching as Dillon moves through the cockpit , searching through pockets and compartments . Schaefer turns his back to the helicopter .</scene_description>
    <character>RAMIREZ</character>
    <dialogue>The pilots have each got one round in the head. And whoever hit it stripped the shit out of it.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Schaefer studies the clearing , eyes always moving , wary . He turns back , looking at the chopper .</scene_description>
    <character>SCHAEFER</character>
    <dialogue>Took'em out with a heat seeker.</dialogue>
    <character>RAMIREZ</character>
    <dialogue>There's something else, Major.</dialogue>
    <character>SCHAEFER</character>
    <dialogue>Mmmnnn?</dialogue>
    <character>RAMIREZ</character>
    <dialogue>I do n't think that was any ordinary army taxi.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Schaefer looks at him quizically .</scene_description>
    <character>RAMIREZ</character>
    <dialogue>looks more like a surveillance bird to me.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Dillon rappells down the line and approaches .</scene_description>
    <character>DILLON</character>
    <dialogue>Have you picked up their trail yet?</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Schaefer taps Ramirez on the shoulder and he moves away . Schaefer turns to Dillon :</scene_description>
    <character>SCHAEFER</character>
    <dialogue>Billy's on it.</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>( indicates chopper . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Heat seeker. Pretty sophisticated for half - asses mountain boys.</dialogue>
    <character>DILLON</character>
    <dialogue>They're getting better equipped every day.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Bill approaches from the b.g.</scene_description>
    <character>BILLY</character>
    <dialogue>Major, looks like there were ten, maybe twelve guerrillas. Looks like they took some prisoners from the chopper.</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>( points . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Then a different set of track, over there.</dialogue>
    <character>SCHAEFER</character>
    <parenthetical>( puzzled . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>What do you mean?</dialogue>
    <character>BILLY</character>
    <dialogue>Six others, U.S. issue jungle boots. They came in from the north, then followed the guerrillas.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Schaefer turns to Dillon .</scene_description>
    <character>SCHAEFER</character>
    <dialogue>Mean anything to you?</dialogue>
    <character>DILLON</character>
    <dialogue>Probably another rebel patrol. They operate in here all the time.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Schaefer is obviously concerned about this . He turns to Billy .</scene_description>
    <character>SCHAEFER</character>
    <dialogue>Get ahead, see what you can find.</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>( to Ramirez . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Slow and easy.</dialogue>
    <character>SCHAEFER</character>
    <parenthetical>( Contd . )</parenthetical>
    <parenthetical>( to Dillon . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>We do n't want any accidents.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Billy takes up the trail , disappearing in to the jungle . Ramirez signals , the team moves out .</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. JUNGLE - DAY</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>As Billy reconnoiters , Ramirez looks back and gives a sign . Schaefer nods and rappels down cliff . As he joins Ramirez , there seem to be butterflies everywhere -</scene_description>
    <character>SCHAEFER</character>
    <dialogue>What's he got?</dialogue>
    <character>RAMIREZ</character>
    <dialogue>Same business, guerrillas hauling two guys from the chopper. followed by men with American equipment.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Ramirez seems concerned by this . Schaefer signals him to move on . Before he follows , Schaefer looks around : there 's something dodgy about this . He goes . Over his head is a butterfly on a limb :</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. JUNGLE - OVERHEAD - DAY</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>As the assault team passes below , a BUTTERFLY lands on what appears to be the BARK of a TREE . It fans its wings and flies on . The impression of the butterfly remains in PERFECT RELIEF , as is imprinted on the bark . The image fades , REVEALING for an instant a gridwork of TINY SCALES on the bark . The bark moves ! Changing colors , like a chameleon , REVEALING for an instant the form of something alive as it flows into the leaves , once again becoming indistinguishable from the surrounding foliage . TWO EYES , faintly flowing yellow , appear in the foliage . They blink , disappearing , and then become VISIBLE again .</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. ALTERED P.O.V. - DAY</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>SEEN THROUGH HEAT - SEEKING VISION , studying the team 's careful , silent movements at they pass by . The SOUNDS of the FOREST are also ALTERED and ENHANCED with an electric , STATICLIKE quality . The Observer scans over the men . and then focuses on Schaefer as he crouches down , signaling forward and rear with a circular motion . He refers to an OBJECT in his hand , studying it carefully .</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. SCHAEFER - DAY</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Using a MAP in lining out a course on his COMPASS . The other team members appear , silently , clustering around him . Using hand signals , Schaefer indicates a course change .</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. OBSERVER'S P.O.V. - DAY</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Watches closely as Schaefer continues with his hand signals , instructing his team .</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. SCHAEFER - DAY</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>OUT</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. DENSE UNDERGROWTH - DAY</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>The hillside of a steep valley , dark and foreboding . Billy passes by and halts , removing his KNIFE . With his other hand he pulls down from overhead a THICK VINE , severing it . A thin stream of WATER emerges which he drinks . Suddenly he stops , letting the water drip to the ground . He quietly releases the vine and brings his M - 203 shotgun to bear , listening intently . Something seems wrong . He brings his eyes upward and stares , hard into the treeline of the opposing hillside . As his eyes strain to penetrate the dense , intertwined canopy , he is engulfed by the rising SOUNDS of the JUNGLE , a cacophony of BUZZING and CLICKING , amplified in the sweltering heat of the day . Unable to locate a source to account for his anxiety , he relaxes , moving on , resuming the track . BILLY -LRB- MINUTES LATER -RRB- examines the ground as he moves , growing confused and puzzled by what he sees before him . He stops , scrutinizing the jungle , probing the world around him with his keen senses . HEARING a faint RUSTLING SOUND he looks up , SEEING a curtain of MOSS several feet away . He takes a cautious step forward , extending his weapon . He reaches forward with his free hand , touching the moss . Behind the curtain a slight shifting of DARK FORMS occurs . He pauses and then with a sudden movement , sweeps the moss aside . A BLACK EXPLOSION of FLUTTERING WINGS as carrion - eating BIRDS rush past Billy 's body . Billy 's face seizes into a mask of horror , his expression descending into a state of complete , primitive shock , his eyes staring transfixed , inches away from the leering death - grin of a HUMAN FACE , upside down , completely stripped of skin . Reeling , his body numbed by the sight before him , he stumbles backwards and stops . Vines threaded through their achilles tendons , the BODIES OF THREE MEN , skinned and gutted , hang suspended in the think , suffocating air , BUZZING with insects . Billy turns away , revulsed as Ramirez moves quietly INTO VIEW , Schaefer directly behind him . Ramirez stares at the bodies , now seen to be in the first stages of deterioration , strips of flesh torn away by the birds and other scavengers . In an almost childlike manner , he crosses himself .</scene_description>
    <character>RAMIREZ</character>
    <parenthetical>( hoarse whisper . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Holy Mother.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Schaefer moves into the clearing , kneeling beside a bloody pile of CLOTHING and ENTRAILS . He examines the clothing and then rises , holding a DOG TAG on a broken chain . He reads the tag , his face growing hardened and bitter as he stares down at the tag , recognizing the name .</scene_description>
    <character>SCHAEFER</character>
    <parenthetical>( to himself . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>J.S. Davis, Captain, U.S. Army.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Schaefer 's eyes move from the bloody dog tag to the bodies .</scene_description>
    <character>SCHAEFER</character>
    <parenthetical>( coldly . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Mac. Cut them down.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Mac moves forward , withdrawing his COMBAT KNIFE . The blade flashes , cutting the vine as the first body THUDS to the ground . He bends over , picking up other DOG TAGS . Schaefer turns to Dillon .</scene_description>
    <character>SCHAEFER</character>
    <dialogue>I knew this man. Green Berets, out of Fort Bragg. What the hell were they doing in here? You got any answers for this, Dillon?</dialogue>
    <character>DILLON</character>
    <parenthetical>( stunned . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Jesus. this is inhuman.</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>( to Schaefer . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Uh. I was n't told of any operations in this area. They should n't have been here.</dialogue>
    <character>SCHAEFER</character>
    <parenthetical>( angry . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Well somebody sent them.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Schaefer walks off . Mac steps out of the clearing , sheathing his knife with a violent gesture , passing Ramirez .</scene_description>
    <character>RAMIREZ</character>
    <parenthetical>( seething . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Must have run into the guerrillas. Fucking animals.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Mac moves alongside Blain .</scene_description>
    <character>MAC</character>
    <parenthetical>( spits . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Ai n't no way for a soldier to die.</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>( looks at Blain . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Time to let ` ol ` painless' out of the bag.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Grimly , Blain RIPS apart the velcro closures of the CANVAS BUNDLE slung across his shoulder , REVEALING a truly awesome weapon , a SIX - BARRELED MINI - GUN adapted for field combat .</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. BILLY - DAY</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Kneels at the side of the original trail examining the ground . He rises , holding a spent CARTRIDGE . Schaefer approaches , kneeling beside him .</scene_description>
    <character>SCHAEFER</character>
    <dialogue>What happened here, Billy?</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Billy looks at him , puzzled .</scene_description>
    <character>BILLY</character>
    <dialogue>Strange, Major. There was a firefight. Shooting in all directions.</dialogue>
    <character>SCHAEFER</character>
    <dialogue>I ca n't believe Jim Hopper walked into an ambush.</dialogue>
    <character>BILLY</character>
    <dialogue>I do n't believe he did, Sir. I could n't find a single track. Just does n't make sense.</dialogue>
    <character>SCHAEFER</character>
    <dialogue>What about the rest of Hopper's men?</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Billy shakes his head .</scene_description>
    <character>BILLY</character>
    <parenthetical>( uncomfortably . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>No sign. They never left here Major.</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>( pause . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>It's like they just disappeared.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Schaefer ponders a moment . Then , to Billy :</scene_description>
    <character>SCHAEFER</character>
    <dialogue>Stick with the guerilla trail.</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>( to team . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Let's get it over with. We move. Five meter spread. No sound. Nothing.</dialogue>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. BLAIN - DAY</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Blain feeds the magazine of BELTED - SHELLS into the weapon , cocking it . He looks up at Mac , his eyes cold , his face taut with anger .</scene_description>
    <character>BLAIN</character>
    <dialogue>Payback time.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Blain hefts the Mini - gun to his hip as Mac draws back slightly on the breech bolt of the M - 60 , letting it snap . They move on , Billy pausing to look at the jungle before disappearing into the foliage .</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. ALTERED P.O.V. - DAY</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>carefully watching this exchange from high in the treetop canopy . The Observer watches as Schaefer turns and leaves the clearing , cautiously moving into the jungle .</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. JUNGLE HILLSIDE - DAY</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Mac appears suddenly , materializing out of the undergrowth , pausing cautiously , his senses alert , intense , almost nervous . He moves on , his huge body barely making a sound as he weaves through the heavy undergrowth . Dillon appears . As he moves on , he crosses over a fallen TREE . Stepping down , his foot breaks through a rotten portion , a CHUCK of the log breaking free and rolling down the hill . Dillon at once goes into a defensive position , listening . The jungle is SILENT . He stands and starts to move forward . Suddenly Mac appears within inches of Dillon 's face . Mac 's face is menacing , angry .</scene_description>
    <character>MAC</character>
    <parenthetical>( hissing ; barely audible . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>You're ghostin' on me, mother fokaaa! I do n't care who you are back in the world. You give away our position again and I'll bleed you quiet and leave your fuckin' ass right here.</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>( hisses ; spits . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Got it?</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Dillon 's eyes are wide and fixed , staring back in cold hatred at Mac , controlling his rage . he knows the rules . Not waiting for a response , Mac turns and vanished into the jungle . Seething with anger Dillon focuses on a still moving LEAF and STEM , indicating Mac 's exit point . He moves on .</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. BLAIN - DAY</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Crouches under heavy foliage , waiting . He is joined by Mac . They glance briefly at each other , scanning in opposite directions for movement and sounds . They speak in whispers .</scene_description>
    <character>BLAIN</character>
    <dialogue>Say, Bull. What's goin' down? We got movement?</dialogue>
    <character>MAC</character>
    <dialogue>No. Shithead with his trenchcoat and dee - coda - da ring was makin' enough noise to get us all waxed. I do n't like that guy. Do n't like him at my back. I ai n't winding up like those bastards back there.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Mac , sweating heavily , wipes the moisture from his brow with his finger . Blain pats the mini - gun affectionately .</scene_description>
    <character>BLAIN</character>
    <dialogue>I know what you mean, Bull, but do n't sweat it, me and ` ol ` painless' here are watchin' the front door.</dialogue>
    <character>MAC</character>
    <dialogue>As always, bro.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>They do a gentle fist dap and smile warmly at each other . Two men who have seen it all , through a dozen no - win situations , and have lived to tell about it . Mac advances a few meters and signals slowly .</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. KNOLL</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>The assault team moving up the hill , barely visible in the heavy foliage , the team moves cautiously into defensive positions . Holding . A moment later they continue up the hill , crawling . On their stomachs , Schaefer and Ramirez clear the edge of the knoll , SEEING below a GUERRILLA VILLAGE , a huge , spreading PALAPA covering implacements dug into a hillside , descending to a winding stream bed below . 30 MEN , dressed in a mixture of jungle fatigues and civilian clothes , armed with AK - 47 ASSAULT RIFLES move about the camp . A heavy MACHINE GUN emplacement guards the entrance to the camp . TWO MEN sit in the camouflaged emplacement . SCHAEFER sweeping the camp with BINOCULARS , SEES a GUARD above the camp . One of the man picks up a hand - held ROCKET LAUNCHER , placing it beside a bandolier of ROCKETS and a RADIO SET and CONSULS taken from the U.S. surveillance helicopter as if preparing to take them away . Schaefer puts down the glasses , looking at Ramirez who nods in acknowledgment . A sudden MUFFLED CRY brings Schaefer 's attention to one end of the camp , where a heavily thatched DOOR covers and opening to the PALAPA . A GUARD stands at the door . The door flies open as a HOSTAGE , shirtless , hands tied behind his back , staggers through the door as if kicked from behind . The man falls to the ground , feebly trying to regain his footing . Although difficult to see from Schaefer 's vantage point , the man 's battered face and welt - covered back indicate he has been severely tortured . Emerging from the palapa , a GUERRILLA LEADER , moustached and wearing a SIDEARM , approaches the beaten man , kicking him viciously in the stomach , rolling him to his side . Kneeling beside the man he withdraws an AUTOMATIC from his holster and cocks the hammer . Grabbing the man by the hair he jams the muzzle into the man 's ear and with a violent twist , pulls the trigger . The guerrilla leader stands and strides quickly back to the palapa , still holding the pistol , closing the door behind him . SCHAEFER grim - faced at having witnesses the murder , lowers him glasses , a look of cold determination on his face . Quickly he and Ramirez ease down the escarpment , joining the other team members . Schaefer makes a circling motion with his thumb and the team members gather in close , huddle formation .</scene_description>
    <character>SCHAEFER</character>
    <parenthetical>( whispering ; angry . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Just killed one of the prisoners. No time for invitations. We take them, now.</dialogue>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. BLAIN AND MAC - DAY</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Crawl silently through the underbrush . With nearly impreceptible movements , Blain slips out of the cartridge pack , ditching the Mini - gun . He withdraws his COMBAT KNIFE , placing it between his teeth . They move through the underbrush in tandem , like two bug cats , stalking . Mac freezes , the sweat pouring from his face , holds up his hand as Blain stops . Using a BLADE OF GRASS , Mac points out a metal TRIP WIRE , following it to a hidden CLAYMORE MINE . Blain grins making a switching GESTURE . Carefully Mac detaches the LEAD WIRES . Directing the mine towards the camp , he reattaches the wires , nodding at Blain .</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. JUNGLE - OVERHEAD - ALTERED P.O.V. - DAY</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>SEEN THROUGH HEAT - SEEKING VISION , FOCUSED ON Blain and Mac , lying in the grass below , their bodies outlined in LUMONOUS AUREOLES . The Observer SEES the NETWORK of TRIP WIRES guarding the approaches to the machine gun nests . The wires GLOW as if ELECTRIFIED , standing out in hard - edged relief in contrast to the jungle foliage . He moves higher into the forest canopy .</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. BILLY - DAY</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>On Schaefer 's signal rises up , pulling a SENTRY to him , covering his mouth with his hand , jerking him backwards and to the side , knocking him off balance with a sweeping motion of his left leg , killing him with his COMBAT KNIFE .</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. SCHAEFER - DAY</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Belly crawls silently through the tall grass just outside and above the main entrance to the camp . He stops , studying the ancient , rusted skeleton of a TRUCK parked on a level spot above the camp , its engine quietly IDLING . The truck is jacked and blocked up , one rear wheel attached to a belt - drive leading to a PUMP , drawing water from a river nearby . In the open cab of the truck a GUARD is on duty , watching the high ground above the camp . Schaefer moves out , heading for the guard .</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. MACHINE GUN EMPLACEMENT - DAY</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>While one Guerrilla attends to his equipment , the OTHER attentively watches the approaches to the camp . He is momentarily distracted by a BUZZING FLY , which he annoyingly swats at with his hand . He hears something to his side . Turning to investigate , the huge , hamhock fist of Mack smashes into his throat . Simultaneously , Blain rises up behind the other man , grabs him by the hair , pulling him down , his COMBAT KNIFE driving downward .</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. TRUCK - DAY</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>A SATCHEL CHARGE is looped over the gearshift lever , resting on the floorboard . Schaefer , lying low across the seat of the truck , turns and looks , SEEING the guard , lying in a heap in the foliage .</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. RAMIREZ - DAY</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Moves into position to the side and above the camp . He carefully checks the readiness of his SIX - SHOT GRENADE LAUNCHER , also setting his MP - 5 in front of him , ready for action .</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. SCHAEFER</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Crouched to the side of the truck , watches the camp , SEEING below through the dense undergrowth , Ramirez , barely visible , signaling . Before him are two FRAGMENTATION GRENADES . He looks at his watch , and then up the hill to : DILLON AND HAWKINS their weapons ready . Dillon picks up his binoculars , focusing on the machine gun emplacement , seeing a MAN , his face covered by a HAT . The head rises , REVEALING the face of Blain , who looks above the camp and slightly nods . Putting his glasses down , motions to Hawkins .</scene_description>
    <character>DILLON</character>
    <parenthetical>( to Hawkins . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Ready, kid?</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Hawkins grins back . Together they slip through the grass , downward towards the edge of the camp . OUT</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. SCHAEFER</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Holds his huge , COMMANDO MACHETE on a diagonal , pushing through the belt , slicing it cleanly . Turning he crawls silently to the rear of the truck , positioning himself behind the rear of the one ton truck . He squats , and with an enormous , concentrated effort , deadlifts the rear of the truck , its rusted springs and frame beginning to CREAK and GROAN slightly . With a herculean effort he lifts the truck free of its blocks and then pushes forward . He rolls aside , disappearing into the ground cover as the truck , its tireless rims digging into the earth , lops down the hill , slowly picking up speed .</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. GUERRILLA VILLAGE - DAY</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>A Guerrilla , alerted by the SOUND of the approaching truck , looks up at the hillside , SEEING the vehicle still moving down the hill at a moderate roll . He CALLS OUT and several Guerrilla leaves their posts , moving out to prepare to stop the truck . The truck rolls into the clearing picking up speed , heading towards the main palapa . The men rush forward , surrounding the truck , trying to slow it down , but the truck rolls , SMASHING through the front wall of the palapa . The men gather around truck and then look back up the hill .</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. ALTERED P.O.V. - DAY</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Watching as Schaefer pulls the pin and launches the GRENADE into the air , the Observer following its arc as it spirals dead - center into the camp , bouncing twice before rolling into the FUEL DUMP . which a moment later , EXPLODES into an incredible FIREBALL . The expanding FIREBALL released from the explosion is to the Observer like an erupting sun , momentarily blinding him .</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. GUERRILLA CAMP - DAY</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>The truck is BLOWN up into the air by the explosion . a moment later the satchel charge DETONATES with an ear - splitting EXPLOSION , tearing the truck apart .</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. SCHAEFER - DAY</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Jumps to his feet , FIRING an M - 203 round into the camp .</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. KNOLL - DAY</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Schaefer races down the hillside , joined by Dillon , leaving Hawkins to cover them . Bullets burst around their feet as they run low , firing short bursts to his left and right . He FIRES the undermounted GRENADE LAUNCHER , sending a round into a gun position in the trees . Still running he breaks open the breach , slamming in another 40mm ROUND from the cartridge pack at his waist . Blain and Mac fire the heavy machine guns , laying down a withering curtain of lead , shredding the camp , taking out five Guerrillas at once .</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. GUERRILLA CAMP - DAY</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>A MAN almost completely ON FIRE is hit by an onslaught of GUNFIRE , ripping him back into the jungle . Ramirez cuts loose a barrage from the SIX - SHOOTER . seconds later the MACHINE GUN IMPLACEMENT erupts in a series of EXPLOSIONS , blowing two Guerrillas into the air . At the HILLSIDE HUT , two Guerrillas move into position by the window , drawing down on Schaefer as he appears , racing down the hill . As they are about to open fire , Dillon appears , YELLING OUT a warning .</scene_description>
    <character>DILLON</character>
    <dialogue>On your nine!</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Schaefer dives , hitting the ground as Dillon OPENS FIRE taking out the Guerrillas . Schaefer rolls to his feet , spins , firing the 203 grenade launcher , completely destroying the hut .</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. ALTERED P.O.V. - DAY</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>As the Observer regains its vision an eerie , surreal experience of sight and sound unfolds : BULLETS streak through the air , leaving blood - red trails of HEAT , like laser blasts . As they impact into the Guerillas , we HEAR the enhanced SLAPPING of BULLETS , SEEING tiny blossoms of HEAT mushroom out of their bodies . We HEAR the horrific , deformed CRIES and SCREAMS of the dying men . Another searing , blinding EXPLOSION sends pieces of SHRAPNEL ripping through the air , some of them ROARING past the Observer 's position , like tiny meteors .</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. GUERRILLA VILLAGE</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>at the entrance way to the main palapa , a Guerrilla stands in the doorway , giving COVER FIRE to his comrades as they fall back inside . Jumping from the roof of the adjoining palapa , Billy drops directly in front of the Guerrilla . From the side , unseen by Billy , another Guerrilla thrusts out with a knife , Billy ducking backwards , the tip of the knife SLASHING his face . With a lightning move , Billy whips his arm up and around the Guerrilla , locking his elbow , breaking the joint . Still holding the man he FIRES , blowing the other Guerrilla off his feet with the SHOTGUN portion of his weapon . He looks at the Guerrilla out of the corner of his eye . He suddenly strikes , breaking his neck , dropping him in a heap . Billy continues on , racing down the stairs , firing the M - 203 . Meanwhile , Blain is crouched next to a tree , providing cover . Behind Blain , at the edge of the camp , circling around from below , TWO GUERRILLAS appear and FIRE a grenade round which EXPLODES behind Blain , fragments ripping into the tree next to which Blain is standing , bark and dirt flying as shrapnel rips into his vest , one piece tearing into his upper shoulder . The hits have no effect on the huge man and with a savage GROWL , he spins , opening fire , raking the two attackers with the Mini - gun . Nearby , Mac charges from the jungle on a dead run , diving over a fallen tree as machine gun FIRE rakes the ground around him . Blain , spotting the sniper high in a tree , opens FIRE with the MINI - GUN , shredding the tree , sending the Guerrilla crashing down through the roof of the palapa .</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>INT. PALAPA - DAY</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>The sniper CRASHES through the roof , landing on the floor near Hawkins and Ramirez who do a quick double take before opening fire on a group of fleeing Guerrillas , taking out two , giving chase to the others . Schaefer and Dillon appear at the top of the staircase , Schaefer freezing as he SEES below a Guerrilla raising an AK - 47 , preparing to fire . Schaefer tackles Dillon , the two men hurling into the air , a moment later BULLETS ripping into the CRATES behind where they were standing . Dillon rises up , kicking over a crate , shooting the Guerrilla who is trying to bring the gun around to fire at him . Schaefer crouches , covering the upper entrances to the palapa , as Ramirez rushes past , joining Schaefer . From the corner of his eye , Schaefer catches a movement . With a whipping , backhanded throw , he lets fly his COMMANDO MACHETE . The machete impales the attacking Guerrilla , driving him backwards , pinning him to a post .</scene_description>
    <character>SCHAEFER</character>
    <dialogue>Stick around.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Schaefer and Ramirez run towards the lower levels , side by side , firing as they go . They reach a door , Schaefer taking out an ATTACKING Guerrilla . Ramirez grabs the side of the door , shoots a look to Schaefer and throws it open . With Schaefer covering him , Ramirez takes a quick peak inside and then rushes into the room .</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>INT. ROOM - DAY</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>At one end is a STAIRWAY , leading to an escape door . A Guerrilla , seen from the waist up , scrambles down the stairs . At the base of the stairs , a Guerrilla , holding an AK - 47 on his hip , turns and starts to fire . Schaefer and Ramirez respond with full AUTO BURSTS which rip into the Guerrilla , spinning him around , knocking over a crude WOODEN TABLE , scattering a BRIEFCASE with burning PAPERS , FOOD CANS , and LIQUOR BOTTLES . As he spins he FIRES the weapon , an arcing line of SLUGS slamming into the tin roof , sending down a shower of rust and dirt . He falls to the ground . Dead . Ramirez charges through the DUST and thick SMOKE to cover the fallen men ; Schaefer following close behind , jerking a new CLIP from his ammo belt . Suddenly , another Guerrilla erupts from behind some ammunition crates , drawing down on Ramirez with a machine pistol .</scene_description>
    <character>SCHAEFER</character>
    <parenthetical>( shouting . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Down!</dialogue>
    <scene_description>As the Guerrilla fires , Schaefer smashes the butt of his empty weapon into the Guerrilla 's shoulder , knocking the gun aside , the SLUGS thudding into the wall harmlessly . He hits the Guerrilla with a vicious glancing blow to the head with the barrel of his weapon . The Guerrilla is hurled backward , crashing into the wooden crates and to the floor . Ramirez , recovering quickly , descends the stairs with catlike agility , disappearing . Schaefer crouches and spins , jamming a new clip into the rifle , scanning the palapa for any other movement . He races to the main door of the room , shouting into the palapa . He SEES Blain charging down the steps . Catching his attention he signals him on , out the back to cover Ramirez .</scene_description>
    <character>SCHAEFER</character>
    <parenthetical>( to Hawkins . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Hawk, Get Con. Op. on the hook! Position and situation, now!</dialogue>
    <scene_description>As Blain runs down the stairs , Hawkins already has the radio off his back , setting up the portable SATELLITE DISH ANTENNA .</scene_description>
    <character>HAWKINS</character>
    <dialogue>You got it, Major!</dialogue>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. PALAPA - WATER AREA - DAY</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Ramirez , Blain and Billy race down the back stairs of the palapa , FIRING Mini - gun , automatic and grenade rounds at the escaping GUERRILLAS as they flee the area , splashing , charging across the shallow river . The guerrillas are history . in no uncertain terms .</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>INT. PALAPA - DAY</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>For the first time , Schaefer studies the interior of the cavernous palapa , SEEING the enormous stockpile of WEAPONS , EQUIPMENT and SUPPLIES stacked along the walls , obviously a major military stronghold hidden deep within the mountains . Mac hustles up to Schaefer , a look of urgency on his face .</scene_description>
    <character>SCHAEFER</character>
    <dialogue>Any sign of the hostages?</dialogue>
    <character>MAC</character>
    <parenthetical>( nods . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>We found'em both, dead. And the gear from the chopper. If they're Central American, I'm a fuckin' Chinaman. By the looks of'em, I'd say our cabinet minister and his aide are CIA.</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>( pause . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Another thing, Major, we were lucky. couple of those guys we waxed are Russians, military advisors by the look of it. Something big was about to happen here.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Schaefer looks at Mac a moment , a flush of anger beginning to show .</scene_description>
    <character>SCHAEFER</character>
    <dialogue>Good work, Mac. Clear the area, no traces. Get the men ready to move.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Schaefer goes back into the room , looking down at the unconscious guerrilla , racking a round into the chamber , reloading his weapon . He kneels , staring into the FACE of a WOMAN , ANNA , dark , late twenties . Despite her blood and dirt - smeared face , she is beautiful .</scene_description>
    <character>SCHAEFER</character>
    <parenthetical>( closes eyes . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Shit.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>He checks her pulse and then slowly he bends to pick up her PISTOL , ejecting the clip . He stands , beginning to shuffle through the PAPERS scattered about the room . Staring at one he looks up , the pieces falling together .</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. JUNGLE - DAY</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Ramirez , at a crouch , runs through the jungle , following the obvious signs of the Guerrilla 's retreat . He emerges from the trees into an opening , leading to a sheer rock cliff , towering fifty feet above the ground . Scanning the wall , he SEES movement and quickly takes cover , as automatic FIRE rips up the ground before him .</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. ROCK WALL - DAY</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Near the center of which a narrow cut , two feet wide , leads to the top of the cliff , giving access to the adjoining ridge . Two Guerrillas scramble up through the chimney , assisted by a ROPE , which with withdraw as they reach the top . Ramirez takes out one man , the other taking cover , returning fire .</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. BASE OF ROCK WALL - DAY</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Blain joins Ramirez , behind cover at the foot of the cliff . As they take cover , Ramirez notices the wound on Blain 's shoulder .</scene_description>
    <character>RAMIREZ</character>
    <dialogue>You're hit. You're bleedin', man.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Blain looks briefly at the wound .</scene_description>
    <character>BLAIN</character>
    <parenthetical>( spits . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Ai n't got time to bleed.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>On a signal , they both clear cover and fire LONG BURSTS from their weapons up the cliff . The smoke is hardly cleared when they are answered by withering FIRE . They duck down as a grenade EXPLODES nearby . Ramirez quickly replaces the 40MM rounds into the SIX - SHOOTER .</scene_description>
    <character>BLAIN</character>
    <dialogue>Son of a bitch's dug in like a Alabama tick.</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>( spits . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>. jack us around all day.</dialogue>
    <character>RAMIREZ</character>
    <dialogue>Hell, dude, we do n't have all day.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Ramirez immediately rolls into the line of fire , BLASTING six RAPID - FIRE shots on a HIGH - ARC trajectory towards the rocks . Blain reacts .</scene_description>
    <character>BLAIN</character>
    <dialogue>Shit, Pancho!</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Blain dives against the protective cover of the rock wall , covering his head . Ramirez casually hops across , squatting next to Blain . They make eye - contact .</scene_description>
    <character>RAMIREZ</character>
    <dialogue>What's your problem, dude?</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Before Blain can answer , Ramirez puts his fingers into his ears and grimaces just as . The entire hillside EXPLODES , blowing the Guerrillas into the air , a torrent of vegetation and earth raining down the cliff , obscuring Blain and Ramirez .</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>INT. PALAPA ROOM - DAY</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Schaefer is staring out the window , his weapon slack in one arm , still holding the paper . Dillon enters , obviously excited about what he has found . He sees the papers on the floor . He reads through them quickly , growing even more excited .</scene_description>
    <character>DILLON</character>
    <dialogue>This is beautiful! More than we ever thought. We got the bastards!</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Schaefer turns , striding slowly to Dillon , handing him the paper he is holding .</scene_description>
    <character>SCHAEFER</character>
    <dialogue>I think this is the one you want.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Dillon reads it .</scene_description>
    <character>DILLON</character>
    <parenthetical>( reacting . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Two days. that's all we had. In two days, three hundred of these bastards would have been equipped with all this. After they crossed the border, it would have taken a year to stop them.</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>( looks up . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>We've averted a major guerrilla invasion, Dutch.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Schaefer moves in close to Dillon , face to face , anger flaring in his eyes .</scene_description>
    <character>SCHAEFER</character>
    <parenthetical>( slow ; deliberate . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>It was all bullshit. All of it. From the start. you set us up, got us in here to do your dirty work.</dialogue>
    <character>DILLON</character>
    <parenthetical>( angry . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>That's right, I set you up. You're a veteran at this, Dutch, I had to.</dialogue>
    <character>SCHAEFER</character>
    <dialogue>Why us?</dialogue>
    <character>DILLON</character>
    <dialogue>Because I told you, you're the best. I knew you could do it but I could n't get you in here without a cover story.</dialogue>
    <character>SCHAEFER</character>
    <dialogue>What story did you give to Davis?</dialogue>
    <character>DILLON</character>
    <dialogue>We've been lookin' for this place for months. The chopper must have gotten close when they got shot down. Hopper was sent in to get my men. He was just doing his job. When he disappeared I had to clean this up, I had to stop there bastards. We were so close, we could n't quit. We could n't sleep through this one. I needed you, Dutch, ca n't you see that?</dialogue>
    <character>DILLON</character>
    <dialogue>To invade a foreign country, illegally? You lied, Dillon. Stacked the odds against us. Set us up. You could have gotten us all killed.</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>( pause ; looking at him . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>You used to be one of us, Dillon, someone I could trust with my life.</dialogue>
    <character>DILLON</character>
    <dialogue>We've been through a lot together Dutch. When we were together, no one could stop us, the hottest Goddamned team the army ever saw. But things changed, I woke up. We're fighting them in a dozen Goddamned countries. It's a fight we ca n't lose, Dutch. We're all expendable assets, ca n't you see that?</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Schaefer takes the paper from Dillon 's hands .</scene_description>
    <character>SCHAEFER</character>
    <dialogue>That's your problem, Dillon. You always did put ambition before the lives of your men.</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>( pause . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>My men are not expendable. I do n't do this kind of work.</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>( crumples up paper in fist . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>This is your dirty little war, not mine.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>He stuffs the crumpled paper into Dillon 's shirt pocket . Anna , regaining consciousness , GROANS , a heavy flow of blood running down her face from her head wound . Hawkins appears at the door .</scene_description>
    <character>HAWKINS</character>
    <dialogue>Major!</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Schaefer turns away from Dillon and steps through the doorway into the palapa as Anna moans again , MUMBLING something in Spanish . Dillon kneels , beside her .</scene_description>
    <character>DILLON</character>
    <parenthetical>( quietly ; in Spanish . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Are you all right?</dialogue>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>INT. PALAPA - DAY</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Schaefer is talking to Hawkins who has the field radio set on a crate just outside the door .</scene_description>
    <character>HAWKINS</character>
    <parenthetical>( urgent . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Major, we stepped into some real shit here. I got a hook - up with aerial surveillance.</dialogue>
    <character>SCHAEFER</character>
    <dialogue>Movement?</dialogue>
    <character>HAWKINS</character>
    <parenthetical>( nods . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Guerrillas swarming like flies all over the place. Ca n't be more then one, maybe two miles away. Place is going down, Major.</dialogue>
    <character>SCHAEFER</character>
    <dialogue>How much time?</dialogue>
    <character>HAWKINS</character>
    <dialogue>Half an hour, maybe less.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Schaefer touches him on the shoulder .</scene_description>
    <character>SCHAEFER</character>
    <parenthetical>( urgently . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Tell Mac we move in five.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>He starts to walk away .</scene_description>
    <character>DILLON</character>
    <parenthetical>( o.s . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>She goes with us.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Schaefer turns . Dillon is at the doorway , supporting the still groggy Anna .</scene_description>
    <character>DILLON</character>
    <dialogue>She's too valuable. She's got to know their whole network. The whole set up. We take her with us.</dialogue>
    <character>SCHAEFER</character>
    <dialogue>We take her and she'll give away our position, every chance she gets. No prisoners, Dillon.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Dillon grabs the handset from Hawkin 's radio , shoving it at Schaefer .</scene_description>
    <character>DILLON</character>
    <dialogue>You're still under orders, Dutch. You want to make the call, or should I?</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Schaefer looks at the handset . Then at Dillon , he knows Dillon 's won . He starts to walk away but stops , turning back , pointing a finger at Dillon .</scene_description>
    <character>SCHAEFER</character>
    <dialogue>I'm getting my men out of this damn jungle, Dillon. She's your baggage. You fall behind, you're on your own.</dialogue>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. GUERRILLA VILLAGE - DAY</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Schaefer and Billy are kneeling on the ground near the trailhead , studying a MAP . In the b.g. , the team , hidden , covers the hillside approaches to the camp , nervous and wary , weapons ready .</scene_description>
    <character>SCHAEFER</character>
    <dialogue>This place is too hot for a pick - up. They wo n't touch us until we're over the border. We can lift at LZ 49, here.</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>( points to map . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Spotter plane says we're cut off.</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>( points to map . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Except for this valley.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Billy shakes his head , following the CONTOUR LINES of the rugged terrain .</scene_description>
    <character>BILLY</character>
    <dialogue>Looks bad, Major. It's gon na be a real bitch.</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>( points to map . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>If we follow above the river and then down, here, at this canyon, we might find a way out.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Schaefer turns to Ramirez , kneeling close by .</scene_description>
    <character>SCHAEFER</character>
    <parenthetical>( decisively . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Not much choice. Pancho, take the lead. Double time it.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>He turns and looks at Dillon , Anna as his side , her forehead bandaged , her hands bound in front of her . He turns back to the others .</scene_description>
    <character>SCHAEFER</character>
    <dialogue>Lock n' load, watch your ass.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Blain moves out , swinging the Mini - gun in front of him as he goes .</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. OBSERVER'S P.O.V. - DAY</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Watching as Dillon leads ANNA onward , SEEING her bound hands . Dillon pushes her .</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. ANNA - DAY</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Spins , hurling a string of insults to Dillon in SPANISH .</scene_description>
    <character>ANNA</character>
    <parenthetical>( in Spanish . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>You touch me again, pig, and I will cut off your balls!</dialogue>
    <character>DILLON</character>
    <parenthetical>( in Spanish . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>It's a long walk back, make it easy on yourself.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>She spits at him , turning forward with a twist of her head . Dillon picks up his back , shouldering it . As they move on , Mac calls out to him .</scene_description>
    <character>MAC</character>
    <parenthetical>( quietly . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Hey, Dillon, over here.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Dillon does n't respond .</scene_description>
    <character>MAC</character>
    <parenthetical>( louder . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Dillon, over here.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Dillon turns and approaches , warily , holding the girl .</scene_description>
    <character>DILLON</character>
    <dialogue>Yeah, what is it, Sergeant?</dialogue>
    <scene_description>MAc unsheathes his knife . He gives Dillon a cold look and turns him by the shoulders . Crawling across the PACK on Dillon 's back is a huge SCORPION . Mac skeweres the scorpion with the tip of his blade , holding it before the wincing Dillon . Anna smirks , nodding to the writhing , stinging insect .</scene_description>
    <character>ANNA</character>
    <parenthetical>( in Spanish . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>When my people catch you, you'll wish you were him.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Dillon looks at Mac .</scene_description>
    <character>DILLON</character>
    <dialogue>Thanks.</dialogue>
    <character>MAC</character>
    <parenthetical>( coolly . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Anytime.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Mac flings the scorpion to the ground , crushing it with his boot . He looks up at Dillon , walks away . Dillon follows , pulling Anna behind him . Billy , guarding the rear , glances furtively around the clearing . He moves a step forward and stops , freezing . Slowly he turns back , his eyes riveted upon the treeline above the camp . His eyes strain , his senses registering a fear he can not name or see . Something is out there , in the trees , waiting , watching . Billy turns and walks into the jungle , pausing one last time to look behind him before he too disappears from sight . The jungle GROWS SILENT .</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. OBSERVER'S ALTERED P.O.V. - DAY</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>LOOKING DOWN from his vantage point TO the treeline below , terraces like stepping stones , FOCUSING ON a TREE , fifty feet away . The Observer utters a LOW TRILL and springs outward into space , hurtling downward towards his landing point , the canopy of the trees approaching in a staccato rush of green . The SOUNDS of the FOREST are again altered and enhanced with an electric , STATIC - LIKE quality as the Observer descends fluidly through the trees and to the ground . He enters the camp , surveying the terrible destruction and carnage . Schaefer , bent , cautious , his feet moving aside the dry leaves on the ground , heel to toe and on foot edges . He glances around , checking the team 's position and progress .     <dialogue>Mac, who did this?</dialogue>

    <character>MAC</character>
    <dialogue>I do n't know. Goddamn it, something. I saw something /.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Ramirez runs from the jungle , breathing hard , shaking his head .</scene_description>
    <character>RAMIREZ</character>
    <dialogue>Nothing. The same thing. Not a fucking trace. No bodies, blood, anything.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Mac stands . Instinctively the team has now grouped around Schaefer , their weapons pointing into the jungle , ready , their nerves on total edge . Schaefer looks upward at the darkening sky .</scene_description>
    <character>SCHAEFER</character>
    <parenthetical>( quietly . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>We're losing the light. Mac, I want a defensive position above this ridge, mined with everything we're got.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Man is again the hardened professional .</scene_description>
    <character>MAC</character>
    <dialogue>Yessir.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Schaefer looks down at Blain 's body . He turns to Ramirez and Billy .</scene_description>
    <character>SCHAEFER</character>
    <dialogue>Put him in his poncho and liner and carry him back. We'll bury him in the morning.</dialogue>
    <character>MAC</character>
    <dialogue>I'll take him.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>ANNA as they leave approaches the brush , her attention focused on something clinging to the leaves , well off to the side of where Mac saw the Hunter . She draws closer , reaching out , hesitant , as if drawn magnetically to the leaves .</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. DETAIL - HUNTER'S BLOOD - DAY</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Clinging to the leaves , thick , viscous , pale - orange , almost like the sap of an exotic plant . Her fingers hover above it , hesitantly , and then touch it . ANNA examines the blood , transfixed . Dillon appears at her shoulder , startling her . He motions for her to return . She turns , wiping the blood onto her pants leg .</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. ENCAMPMENT - DUSK</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>The team is dug into the foxholes in a dense grove of trees , a solid wall to their backs . The men are barely visible they blend in so well . Nearby , Mac is stringing a TRIP WIRE , low to the ground , covering it with leaves and grass . He moves into camp and reports to Schaefer .</scene_description>
    <character>MAC</character>
    <dialogue>We've got most of the flares, frags. and two claymores just outside. Nothin's comin' close to here without trippin' on somethin'.</dialogue>
    <character>SCHAEFER</character>
    <dialogue>Thank you, Sergeant.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Mac starts to go but Schaefer places his hand on his shoulder .</scene_description>
    <character>SCHAEFER</character>
    <dialogue>I'm sorry, Bull. It's never easy. He was a good soldier.</dialogue>
    <character>MAC</character>
    <parenthetical>( hardened . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>The best friend I ever had.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Mac turns and walks through the camp , stopping beside a DARK OBJECT on the ground . He kneels beside the PONCHO pulling back the zipper REVEALING Blain 's face , looking peaceful in death , as if lying in state . Mac removes something from his pocket , holding it in his hand , studying it . DETAIL OF OBJECT IN MAC 'S HAND The small WHISKEY FLASH , the chrome rubbed away in places REVEALING the brass beneath and a MEDALLION depicting the 101 1ST AIRBORNE DIVISION . MAC takes a tiny sip from the flask . He replaces the cap and lifts the flap of Blain 's shirt pocket , placing the flask inside . He lingers on the face and then closes the zipper .</scene_description>
    <character>MAC</character>
    <parenthetical>( softly . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Good - bye, Bro.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>ANNA is huddles into a foxhole , her hands still tied in front of her . She looks down at her pants leg . The Hunter 's BLOODSTAIN glows with a faint luminosity . She places her fingers near the stain .</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>INT. HUNTER'S SHIP - NIGHT</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Hawkins ' BODY impacts the floor with a THUMP .</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. ENCAMPMENT - DAY (DUSK)</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>A momentary HUSH falls over the symphony of night sounds . Anna and Billy turn towards the trees with a growing look of wariness . The others , setting up the RADIO , show no response .</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>INT. HUNTER'S SHIP - DAY (DUSK)</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>The Hunter 's foot steps on the upper leg of the corpse , the PREHENSILE SPUR digging deep , pinioning the body to the ground . The Hunter 's HAND extends , his FINGERS puncturing the skin at the base of the spine , gripping the vertebrae . With otherworldly strength the arm pulls , the entire SPINAL COLUMN ripping free from the body , a sickly SNAPPING and POPPING of cartilage separating from bone and tissue .</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. ENCAMPMENT - DAY (DUSK)</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Ramirez is tuning in the compact FIELD RADIO , equipped with a CRYPTO - PHONE device . Dillon holds the handset .</scene_description>
    <character>DILLON</character>
    <parenthetical>( to phone . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Blazer One, say again.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>A CRACKLE of STATIC over the radio .</scene_description>
    <character>BLAZER ONE</character>
    <parenthetical>( voice over . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Red Fox, I say again. Your request for extraction denied. Your area still compromised. Proceed to Sector 3000 for prisoner extraction, Priority Alpha. Next contact at 1030 hours.</dialogue>
    <character>DILLON</character>
    <parenthetical>( to phone ; angry . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Roger, Blazer One. 1030 hours. damn, bastards.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>He puts down the phone , turning to the group , huddled together in a tight circle , Ramirez and Billy facing outward in defensive positions , Anna , silent , watching . Schaefer is look at him .</scene_description>
    <character>DILLON</character>
    <parenthetical>( angry ; shocked . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>We're still too far in, they wo n't risk coming in for us.</dialogue>
    <character>SCHAEFER</character>
    <dialogue>Expendable assets, Dillon. Seems Langley is never around when you need them.</dialogue>
    <character>DILLON</character>
    <dialogue>I can accept that, it comes with the job.</dialogue>
    <character>SCHAEFER</character>
    <dialogue>Bullshit. You're just like the rest of us.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Dillon glares back . Schaefer leaves , lost in thought . Ramirez looks up at the impenetrable canopy .</scene_description>
    <character>RAMIREZ</character>
    <dialogue>Shit load o' good a chopper'd do us in here anyway.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Dillon turns to Mac .</scene_description>
    <character>DILLON</character>
    <dialogue>Mac. Who hit us today?</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Mac is still obviously feeling the anger and bitterness of the mystifying event .</scene_description>
    <character>MAC</character>
    <dialogue>Do n't know, only saw one of'em. Camouflaged. He was there.</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>( remembering . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>. Those fucking eyes.</dialogue>
    <character>DILLON</character>
    <parenthetical>( abruptly ; pushing . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>What, Sergeant?</dialogue>
    <character>MAC</character>
    <parenthetical>( returning ; angry . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Those eyes. disappeared. But I know one thing, Major.</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>( pause . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>. I drew down and fired right at it. Capped - off two hundred rounds and then the Mini - gun ; the full pack. Nothin'. nothin' on this earth could have lived. not at that range.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Dillon ponders this for a moment , staring hard at Mac . Mac gets up .</scene_description>
    <character>MAC</character>
    <dialogue>I've got the first watch.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Mac departs . Dillon watches Mac as he creeps forward to the sentry position . He turns to Ramirez .</scene_description>
    <character>DILLON</character>
    <dialogue>Ask her again. What did she see? What happened to Hawkins?</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Ramirez turns to Anna . They talk quietly in Spanish , Dillon watching , listening carefully . Ramirez turns back to Dillon .</scene_description>
    <character>RAMIREZ</character>
    <parenthetical>( interpreting . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>She says the same thing. It was the jungle.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Ramirez looks up at Billy who continues to stare into the jungle , aware , catlike , reacting to every sound , his nerves on edge , as if ready to snap . Ramirez rises , moves alongside his friend , Dillon watching closely .</scene_description>
    <character>RAMIREZ</character>
    <parenthetical>( whispering ; imploring . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>You know something Billy, what is it?</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Billy turns , his face a mask of primal fear . He moves close to Ramirez .</scene_description>
    <character>BILLY</character>
    <dialogue>I'm scared.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Ramirez is frightened by this .</scene_description>
    <character>RAMIREZ</character>
    <parenthetical>( shaken . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Bullshit. You ai n't afraid of no man.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Billy looks deep into his eyes , chilling Ramirez to the bone , looking at his with eyes which have seen on an instinctual level what the others have so far only begun to sense .</scene_description>
    <character>BILLY</character>
    <dialogue>There's something out there, waiting for us. it ai n't no man.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Billy turns away , moving a short distance away , taking up his position . Dillon looks after him and then into the blackness of the jungle canopy . Dillon speaks to Ramirez .</scene_description>
    <character>DILLON</character>
    <dialogue>He's losing his cool. There's nothing out there but a couple of men that we're going to have to take down.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Despite his words , there is an edge of doubt in his voice . Schaefer returns . He 's overheard this exchange . He 's holding the group of DOG TAGS taken from Davis ' men . He holds them up for Dillon to see .</scene_description>
    <character>SCHAEFER</character>
    <dialogue>You still do n't get it, do you Dillon? He took Davis. and now he wants us.</dialogue>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>INT. HUNTER'S SHIP - NIGHT</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>CLOSE ON an oval CHAMBER made of an otherworldly looking metal with a strange copperlike patina , its interior bathed in INTENSE BLUE LIGHT . In the chamber is Hawkins ' SKULL CAP and SPINAL COLUMN still attached . The light field suddenly changes as all connective tissue , flesh and blood and drawn away from the bony structures with incredible force , disintegrating as they rush toward the sides of the chamber . The light changes in frequency to a dull glow as the Hunter 's hands remove the GLAZED , POLISHED trophy from the chamber . He turns , carefully placing it upon a GLOWING SURFACE . He touches the trophy gently , feeling its texture , as a man might touch the hide of a big cat . He pulls his hand away and instantly an opaque FORCE FIELD covers the trophies .</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. MAC - NIGHT (LATER)</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Hunched down in a foxhole , the Mini - gun on a tripod before him . It 's nearly a FULL MOON , the jungle a montage of SHADOWS AND REFLECTIONS . Mac stares into the night , his eyes always moving .</scene_description>
    <character>MAC</character>
    <parenthetical>( distant ; whispering . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>It's the same kinda jungle, Bro, same moon. everything.</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>( pause . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>. a real number ten night. Remember Bro? Only you and me, the only one's out of the whole fuckin' platoon who made it out.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>His eyes probe the darkness , remembering .</scene_description>
    <character>MAC</character>
    <dialogue>we walked out on top of'em. Not a scratch, not a fuckin' scratch.</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>( spits into the night . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>No fuckin' chili - choker got to you, Bro. you were just too good.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>He ponders this a moment .</scene_description>
    <character>MAC</character>
    <dialogue>I promise you this, Bro. whoever he is, I hope he's plannin' to hit us again.</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>( pauses ; spits . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>.'cause he's got my name on'em.</dialogue>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>INT. HUNTER'S SHIP - NIGHT</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>A FORCE FIELD that permeates the jungle , becoming one with the trees and foliage . The Hunter walks down a CORRIDOR of SOLID LIGHT , leading to an opening to the jungle . As the Hunter reaches the doorway he changes from visible to invisible , moving on into the night .</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. ENCAMPMENT - NIGHT</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>The mist has thickened , the night alive with a million JUNGLE SOUNDS . The team members sleep uneasily , if at all . Mac , although weary , stares hard into the night , waiting , each small sound a potential enemy . A LULL spreads over the jungle , animals and insects QUIETING . Mac tightens his grip on the Mini - gun . Billy awakens , peering into the night . Nothing . Suddenly , a metallic CLICK , a POP , the SOUND of a warning flare rocketing into the canopy . A moment later a brilliant FLASH as the flare burns , illuminating the camp . An echoing eerie SCREAM fills the night as a DARK SHAPE in the mist rockets through the undergrowth towards Mac . Mac spins , hauling the heavy gun around , just as something crashes into his upper body , driving the huge man into the foxhole . A desperate battle for life ensues , illuminated with the strobing light of the descending flare . Mac 's enraged SHOUTS and ROARS mingled with horrific SCREAMS fill the night . Mac 's razor - edged KNIFE slashes in the light ; BLOOD spatters his face as he attacks fiercely . Schaefer and Ramirez rush at a crouching run towards the foxhole , their weapons ready . A tremendous climatic SCREAM from the foxhole AND THEN , SILENCE . Schaefer and Ramirez approach , cautiously . Mac stands , his face and clothes drenched in blood , some of it his , his breath coming in rapid gasps . He looks at Schaefer , whispering hoarsely .</scene_description>
    <character>MAC</character>
    <dialogue>Got the motherfucker.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>As the flare breaks through the canopy , dying out in great flickering bursts , the man stare down into the foxhole . A huge , jungle BOAR lies mutilated in a pool of blood , still quivering in the final throes of death . The flare dies out . Mac , shaking from adrenalin , breathing heavily , looks down at the dying animal .</scene_description>
    <character>MAC</character>
    <parenthetical>( incredulous . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>A pig. just a fucking pig.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Schaefer shines his TEKNA - LIGHT onto the boar , playing the light along its massive hulk , its razor edges tusks gleaming in the light . Ramirez appears by his side , looking down at the huge carcass .</scene_description>
    <character>RAMIREZ</character>
    <dialogue>Holy shit, Mac.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Nearby , unnoticed by the men , Anna stoops , her hands still bound , picking up an MP - 5 from the ground . She turns , looking for an avenue of escape , running for the jungle . But the forest looks foreboding and sinister . She stops , staring at the jungle , the moonlight reflected off leaves like a thousand eyes . For a brief second she imagines she can see the Hunter 's eyes , crashing towards her , the shifting patterns of light and dark making the jungle seem to strobe , like it is about to rush in at her . She freezes , paralyzed by fear , by her memories of the attack . She drops the MP - 5 to the ground . Back at the foxhole , Schaefer and Ramirez help the still shaken Mac from the hole . Schaefer looks at Mac , at the huge gash across his chest .</scene_description>
    <character>SCHAEFER</character>
    <dialogue>Get a field dressing on that right away.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Suddenly he remembers , Anna .</scene_description>
    <character>SCHAEFER</character>
    <dialogue>Where's the girl?</dialogue>
    <scene_description>They all turn , ready to move and then stop . Coming forth from the shadows Anna appears , still frightened , seeking the security of the soldiers . From the darkness nearby , Billy 's VOICE in a hoarse WHISPER .</scene_description>
    <character>BILLY</character>
    <parenthetical>( o.s. ; urgently . )</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Major, over here.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Schaefer turns , apprehensive , something in Billy 's voice . He walks over to Billy , standing with a FLASHLIGHT pointing to the ground . They see Blain 's BODY BAG slashed open , covered in blood . Ramirez appears .</scene_description>
    <character>BILLY</character>
    <dialogue>The body. it's gone.</dialogue>
    <character>RAMIREZ</character>
    <dialogue>Came in through the trip wires, took it right out from under our noses.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Anna appears between Schaefer and Ramirez , staring down at the empty , blood - soaked body bag . She looks up , into Schaefer 's eyes .</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. ENCAMPMENT - DAY (PRE-DAWN)</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>A patchy GROUND FOG covers the area . Anna , in her foxhole , awakens , LISTENING to the rising SOUNDS of the jungle .
