    <scene_description>He walks off, resigned. The weight of the world.</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. BOSTON - MORNING</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Sun rises over the city.</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>INT. SANDY'S APARTMENT - MORNING</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Breakfast time chaos. Sandy barrels through, pulls his jacket on, grabs his laptop case, steps over the dog--</scene_description>
    <character>TRISH</character>
    <dialogue>Lunch!</dialogue>
    <scene_description>He swings back over, grabs a brown bag from Trish, gives her a quick kiss. Heads out.</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. PROMINENCE FINANCIAL GROUP BUILDING - BOSTON - DAY</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>A skyscraper downtown.</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>INT. SANDY'S OFFICE - TIME PASSING</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>The placard next to the door says: Sandy Patterson - Accounts Processing. The office is basically a glorified cubicle. Sandy works industriously. STAMPS and NOTARIZES documents. Legal disclaimers are SCANNED and EMAILED. Fills in IRS forms. Bank forms. SEC forms. FINRA forms. Trade authorization forms. Sandy Patterson is a master of paperwork and detail. And at NOON sharp: he stops. The inbox is EMPTY. He takes out his lunch. There's a note in the bag from Trish. "Something good will happen today."</scene_description>
    <character>BRYAN</character>
    <dialogue>Patterson!</dialogue>
    <scene_description>BRYAN CASEY, 31, sharp suit, standing in Sandy's doorway. Younger than Sandy, but far better dressed.</scene_description>
    <character>BRYAN</character>
    <dialogue>Did I ask you to paper the Westfield sweep account under the holding corp?</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Yup.</dialogue>
    <character>BRYAN</character>
    <dialogue>Shit. It was supposed to go under--</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>--the subsidiary, so you can roll over the qualified plan.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Sandy hands Bryan an envelope.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>I did it both ways. Had a feeling.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Bryan takes the forms. Relieved. Points happily as he exits.</scene_description>
    <character>BRYAN</character>
    <dialogue>You're the best, Patterson. The best.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Sandy enjoys the moment. A little pride in himself, for once. The PHONE RINGS. He answers, chipper.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>This is Sandy Patterson.</dialogue>
    <character>SECRETARY (ON PHONE)</character>
    <dialogue>Mr. Cornish needs you in his office for a notarize.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Oh! Uh, sure, right away!</dialogue>
    <scene_description>He hangs up. Looks at Trish's note. Something good. It's up to him to make it happen...</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>INT. JIM CORNISH'S OFFICE - MOMENTS LATER</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Sandy enters the large, plush corner office. JIM CORNISH, 50, is a short, imperious man. The big wheel. He barely acknowledges Sandy's existence. Just waves at three forms on the coffee table.</scene_description>
    <character>CORNISH</character>
    <dialogue>New account forms. Stamp 'em.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Sandy takes out a notary book and stamp. Works up the courage.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Uh, Jim?</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Cornish looks at Sandy. Why is this peon talking?</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>I know your time is limited, so I thought I'd squeeze this in. I've been here five years, and I haven't gotten a raise. Now I know times are--</dialogue>
    <character>CORNISH</character>
    <dialogue>Yes!</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Yes?</scene_description>
    <character>CORNISH</character>
    <dialogue>There's the man!!!</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Cornish gets up, walks right past Sandy to greet the client who just walked into the office. Sandy turns to see Cornish man-hugging: LARRY BIRD. The Celtic great. The most famous man in Boston.</scene_description>
    <character>CORNISH</character>
    <dialogue>God, you look terrific. Linda! Two coffees! C'mon, sit down.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Sandy can't believe this. He's awestruck.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Larry Bird. I'm--</dialogue>
    <character>CORNISH</character>
    <dialogue>Just get the stamp out.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Larry signs the three forms, watching as Sandy fumbles to open his ink pad.</scene_description>
    <character>LARRY BIRD</character>
    <dialogue>Who's this? The investment guy in charge of signatures?</dialogue>
    <character>CORNISH</character>
    <dialogue>Ha. No, he's not an investment guy. He just handles the paperwork.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>I'm like an assistant investment guy.</dialogue>
    <character>CORNISH</character>
    <dialogue>Mmmmmmmm, not quite as good that. He's more like someone who works for investment guys, but isn't an investment guy and doesn't have the training or license to ever be an investment guy.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <parenthetical>(clinging to dignity)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>I provide back office support for--</dialogue>
    <character>CORNISH</character>
    <dialogue>Actually, he's a bit like those guys who gave you towels, mopped up your sweat? Hung around Celtics, but weren't Celtics?</dialogue>
    <character>LARRY BIRD</character>
    <parenthetical>(laughs at Sandy)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Oh, you're the sweat guy! Hey, every team needs a sweat guy.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Cornish laughs with Larry. Sandy forces himself to join in. But he's dying inside. Cornish points to the forms.</scene_description>
    <character>CORNISH</character>
    <dialogue>Go ahead and stamp.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Of course. I'll just need a valid form of ID... driver's license?</dialogue>
    <character>LARRY BIRD</character>
    <dialogue>Oh. I left my wallet in the car.</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>(to Cornish)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>I'll email you the number.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Oh. Um-- I do need to see it.</dialogue>
    <character>LARRY BIRD</character>
    <dialogue>I just told you, I don't have it.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Maybe you could run down and get it?</dialogue>
    <character>CORNISH</character>
    <dialogue>Are you out of your mind?</dialogue>
    <character>LARRY BIRD</character>
    <dialogue>Are you saying I'm not Larry Bird?</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>No, of course not! But I took a public oath. I can't notarize a document without confirming ID.</dialogue>
    <character>CORNISH</character>
    <dialogue>His FACE is his ID, you jackass!</dialogue>
    <character>LARRY BIRD</character>
    <dialogue>I'm Larry Bird!</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>I know! But the rules-- !</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Larry Bird stands up. Furious.</scene_description>
    <character>LARRY BIRD</character>
    <dialogue>I am six foot nine! This is BOSTON!</dialogue>
    <character>CORNISH</character>
    <dialogue>Stamp it, Patterson!</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Larry Bird grabs for the stamp. Sandy clutches it to his chest, frightened.</scene_description>
    <character>LARRY BIRD</character>
    <dialogue>I AM LARRY BIRD! I AM THE GREATEST</dialogue>
    <character>OF ALL TIME! STAMP IT!</character>
    <dialogue>CORNISH</dialogue>
    <character>STAMP IT!</character>
    <dialogue>LARRY BIRD</dialogue>
    <character>STAMP IT! STAMP IT!</character>
    <dialogue>SANDY</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Okay!!! Sandy stamps each of the three contracts. WHACK! WHACK! WHACK!</scene_description>
    <character>CORNISH</character>
    <dialogue>Now get out.</dialogue>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>INT. SANDY'S OFFICE - CONTINUOUS</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Sandy slumps back into his office, sits down. Hot with shame. Something good will happen today. He CRUMPLES the note up and throws it out. His PHONE RINGS, startling him. He answers. No longer chipper.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>This is Sandy Patterson.</dialogue>
    <character>CALLER (ON PHONE)</character>
    <dialogue>Yes, Sandy? I'm Jeanette with Lady's Choice salon confirming your appointment for this Wednesday at three?</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>I'm sorry, you have the wrong number.</dialogue>
    <character>CALLER (ON PHONE)</character>
    <dialogue>Sandy Bigelow Patterson?</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Odd. His middle name. That gets his attention.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Yes, but--</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>(checks the caller ID)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Where are you calling from?</dialogue>
    <character>CALLER (ON PHONE)</character>
    <dialogue>Homestead, Florida.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>I'm in Boston. How did you get this number?</dialogue>
    <character>CALLER (ON PHONE)</character>
    <dialogue>You didn't leave one when you made the appointment, so we Googled you.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Well, I'm sorry, but you have the wrong person.</dialogue>
    <character>CALLER (ON PHONE)</character>
    <dialogue>Are you sure?</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>You're Lady's Choice in Florida. I'm a man in Massachusetts.</dialogue>
    <character>CALLER (ON PHONE)</character>
    <dialogue>So you're not Sandy Patterson?</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>No! I'm no one! GOODBYE!</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Sandy slams the phone down. A knock on his door. It's Bryan Casey, looking deadly serious.</scene_description>
    <character>BRYAN</character>
    <dialogue>We need to talk.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Oh no.</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>INT. EMERGENCY STAIRWELL - OFFICE BUILDING - MOMENTS LATER</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Bryan enters the stairwell. Stonefaced. Sandy follows.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Bryan, you gotta understand, this Larry Bird thing wasn't my--</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Sandy stops. Bryan's there, but so are THREE OTHER GUYS. All in expensive suits. All around 30. All looking at him.</scene_description>
    <character>BRYAN</character>
    <dialogue>We're leaving Prominence.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <parenthetical>(stunned)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>You guys book half the business here.</dialogue>
    <character>BRYAN</character>
    <dialogue>We know. And if it were up to Cornish, we'd be sucking his ass for the rest of our lives. That's why we're starting our own firm, and we're taking all of our clients with us.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Jesus-- that's a four billion dollar portfolio...</dialogue>
    <character>BRYAN</character>
    <dialogue>Five. Come with us.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Sandy is floored. Him?</scene_description>
    <character>BRYAN</character>
    <dialogue>You're the best at what you do. You'll be a junior partner. Run the back office, plus a piece of the business. What are you making now?</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Fifty.</dialogue>
    <character>BRYAN</character>
    <dialogue>You're gonna make fifty next month.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Oh my god. When is this happening?</dialogue>
    <character>BRYAN</character>
    <dialogue>Now.</dialogue>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>INT. OFFICE AREA - CONTINUOUS</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Bryan and his partners stride out to the middle of the floor, amidst the cubicles and offices. Sandy follows, hanging back, as Bryan picks up a STAPLER and BANGS ON THE WALL, getting everyone's attention. He steps up and stands on a desk.</scene_description>
    <character>BRYAN</character>
    <dialogue>The four of us are leaving to start a new company.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>He raises his Blackberry and presses a button.</scene_description>
    <character>BRYAN</character>
    <dialogue>You now have our new contact info.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Everyone stops. You can hear a pin drop. This is nuclear.</scene_description>
    <character>BRYAN</character>
    <dialogue>We will need secretaries. Clerks. IT. You can submit applications on--</dialogue>
    <character>CORNISH</character>
    <dialogue>NOBODY MOVE.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Cornish stands across the way. Addresses the troops.</scene_description>
    <character>CORNISH</character>
    <dialogue>Anyone who stays right where they are gets a 5% raise, here and now.</dialogue>
    <character>CORNISH</character>
    <dialogue>Anyone who moves-- will regret it. This firm has offices in twenty cities across five continents. You don't want us for an enemy.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Sandy takes that in. The raise. The threat. SECURITY grabs hold of the four rebels.</scene_description>
    <character>BRYAN</character>
    <dialogue>Last chance. Who's with us?</dialogue>
    <scene_description>The room is dead silent. No one moves. Cornish gloats.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>I am.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Cornish looks around, searching for the traitor.</scene_description>
    <character>CORNISH</character>
    <dialogue>Who said that?</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <parenthetical>(petrified)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>I did.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Cornish stares in disbelief and fury at Sandy. As security marches him out with Bryan and the others--</scene_description>
    <character>CORNISH</character>
    <dialogue>You better pray this works out, Patterson, because I'm killing you everywhere else! No one will hire you! Not here, not anywhere! You hear me? You're a dead man! In this town, in this business! Everywhere you go! WHO DO YOU THINK YOU ARE? WHO DO YOU THINK YOU ARE???</dialogue>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>INT. SHOPPING MALL - FLORIDA - SAME TIME</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Diana rides up the escalator, drinking an Orange Julius, talking on a crappy cell phone.</scene_description>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>Of course I appreciate it. Yes. Ugh, fine. "Thank you for bailing me out, Moshe." I don't know. Figure two weeks. I'll be done in an hour, and then it's all yours. Okay?</dialogue>
    <scene_description>As she steps off the elevator, the phone goes BOOP. Call dropped. She casually TOSSES the phone into a TRASH BIN. IN THE JEWELRY STORE She points a ring out to the saleswoman. Credit card in hand.</scene_description>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>That one looks great. Lost my wedding ring. Can you believe it? Fifteen years. He's a big stockbroker. But it's not about stuff, you know? It's about partnership.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>AUNTIE ANNE'S PRETZELS Diana stuffs an entire cinnamon sugar pretzel in her mouth. Talks to the cashier through a wad of dough.</scene_description>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>Mmm. Low blood sugar. It's working. This is very fresh.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>COSMETICS COUNTER The salesgirl SWIPES the card. Diana shows off her new ring.</scene_description>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>Yeah, we just got married. He's a surgeon. He fixes smiles.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Diana hears some whispered GIGGLING. Turns to catch two counter girls quietly mocking her appearance. She pretends to not notice. AUNTIE ANNE'S PRETZELS Diana has another pretzel in her mouth. Talks through an even larger quantity of dough to the same cashier.</scene_description>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>Another crash. It's picking up. Is that a free sample? Is that onion?</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>(chokes, then clears)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Mmm. There's a nice tang to that.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>SPORTING GOODS STORE Diana looks at a monitor showing footage for something called FAMILY FUN PACKAGE. A happy family is whitewater rafting.</scene_description>
    <character>SPORTING GOODS SALESMAN</character>
    <dialogue>So how old are your kids?</dialogue>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>15, 12, 10, 8 and 6. Jaden, Cathy, Sam, JP and Anna.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>She eyes the large yellow inflatable on display.</scene_description>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>Huh. I could buy raft...</dialogue>
    <scene_description>BROOKSTONE Diana VIBRATES in a massage chair. Asleep. Drooling. An employee nudges her. She wakes spastically.</scene_description>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>What the fuck?</dialogue>
    <character>BROOKSTONE EMPLOYEE</character>
    <dialogue>Ma'am? Your card and your receipt?</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Oh. She gets her bearings. Checks the receipt. One massage chair plus home delivery. $1,899.99. Diana does some math in her head, then hands the card back to the salesman.</scene_description>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>Keep it. It's done.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>The salesman takes the card back, confused. Diana turns over on the massage chair so that's she face down. Still vibrating.</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>INT. SANDY'S CAR - SAME TIME</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>A Yaris. Sandy drives, cell phone to his ear. It's ringing. BOOP. He checks his phone. TRISH (HOME) - CALL FAILED. The LOW GAS alert pings on the dashboard.</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. GAS STATION - EVENING</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Sandy's redialing Trish as he swipes his card at the pump. Boop. Dropped call. Again. The pump says DECLINED - SEE MANAGER. Huh?</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>INT. GAS STATION - MOMENTS LATER</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>The attendant, ARUN, sits in his glassed-in cashier booth, talking loudly in HINDI on his BLUETOOTH earpiece.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Excuse me? Something's wrong with pump 5. It's not taking my card.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Sandy passes it through the tray. Arun takes it, swipes it...</scene_description>
    <character>ARUN</character>
    <dialogue>Oh, look at this, buddy!</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Arun holds up the scanner. It says INVLD. - DESTROY CARD.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>What? Why would it say that?</dialogue>
    <character>ARUN</character>
    <dialogue>Because you don't pay your fucking bills, deadbeat!</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>I absolutely pay my bills! And you can't talk to customers like that!</dialogue>
    <character>ARUN</character>
    <dialogue>Yes I can. Bulletproof glass. Suck my balls.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Arun starts talking in Hindi on his bluetooth. Laughs.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Who is that? Who are you talking to?</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Arun turns a WEBCAM toward Sandy's credit card.</scene_description>
    <character>ARUN</character>
    <dialogue>My family in Mumbai. They're watching me cut up your card. I'm slingboxing this shit to them.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Do not cut that card up!</dialogue>
    <scene_description>He CUTS THE CARD. Then hits SPEAKER on his cell phone. We hear people laughing, singing and clapping.</scene_description>
    <character>ARUN</character>
    <dialogue>Ha ha! You like this song? The chorus means "fuck you".</dialogue>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>INT. SANDY'S CAR - MOMENTS LATER</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Sandy drives, fuming. Phone to his ear. It's ringing.</scene_description>
    <character>LORETTA (ON PHONE)</character>
    <dialogue>Hello, this is Loretta with MobiCom. With whom am I speaking?</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Sandy Patterson.</dialogue>
    <character>LORETTA (ON PHONE)</character>
    <dialogue>And can I have the last four of your social?</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>LORETTA (ON PHONE)</dialogue>
    <scene_description>And how may I assist you this evening?</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>I can't seem to make any calls.</dialogue>
    <character>LORETTA (ON PHONE)</character>
    <dialogue>Yes, I see we've suspended your service for an overdue balance of $369.73.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>No, that's a mistake. I pay this bill regularly.</dialogue>
    <character>LORETTA (ON PHONE)</character>
    <dialogue>I'm sorry, sir. If you'd like to pay by phone right now, we can restore service to all three of your numbers.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Three? What three? I have two numbers. My wife and myself.</dialogue>
    <character>LORETTA (ON PHONE)</character>
    <dialogue>I'm showing a third line, added two months ago. Area code 305-697--</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>305? Where is that?</dialogue>
    <character>LORETTA (ON PHONE)</character>
    <dialogue>Homestead, Florida.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Homestead. Where that salon was? And then: Whoooo! Flashing sirens behind him.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Shit.</dialogue>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. SANDY'S CAR - MOMENTS LATER</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Sandy's pulled over. The COP approaches his window.</scene_description>
    <character>COP</character>
    <dialogue>We have a hands-free phone law, sir. License and registration.</dialogue>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. SANDY'S CAR - MOMENTS LATER</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>The cop walks back over. Hand on the butt of his gun.</scene_description>
    <character>COP</character>
    <dialogue>Step out of the car, Mr. Patterson.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <parenthetical>(gets out)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Really? Okay. Didn't realize it was that big of a-- OW!</dialogue>
    <scene_description>The cop SPINS HIM AROUND. SLAMS HIM against the hood of his car. Arm bent behind his back.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>INT. BOSTON POLICE STATION - INTERVIEW ROOM - EVENING</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Sandy sits alone. Handcuffed. Shell-shocked. Two DETECTIVES enter. Close the door behind them. The lead detective is REILLY, 40's. Moustache. Men's Wearhouse.</scene_description>
    <character>DET. REILLY</character>
    <dialogue>Mr. Patterson, I'm Detective Reilly.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Listen, there's been a mistake.</dialogue>
    <character>DET. REILLY</character>
    <dialogue>There's no mistake. The arresting officer ran your license through the NCIC. You were booked for felony assault two weeks ago in Florida.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Florida? Wait-- was it Homestead?</dialogue>
    <character>DET. REILLY</character>
    <dialogue>Oh good, so we're dropping the whole "there's been a mistake". You missed your court date this morning. Judge issued a warrant, we ship you down there tomorrow. Enjoy the weather.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Waitwaitwait. Listen. Please! Someone with my name is doing these things. Making salon appointments, opening phone accounts--</dialogue>
    <character>DET. REILLY</character>
    <dialogue>Are you or are you not Sandy Bigelow Patterson, born May 18th, 1973?</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>I am, but-- I swear! This is someone else. It's not me.</dialogue>
    <character>DET. REILLY</character>
    <parenthetical>(beat, then to his partner)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Call Homestead PD. Pull the mugshot.</dialogue>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>INT. INTERVIEW ROOM - LATER</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Reilly's partner walks back in the room. Hands Reilly a folder. Reilly opens it. Examines what's inside.</scene_description>
    <character>DET. REILLY</character>
    <dialogue>Woof. Uncuff him.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>The partner removes Sandy's cuffs. Reilly takes a document from the folder, puts it on the table. Turns it toward Sandy. It's the MUGSHOT of DIANA. Holding a name card and birthdate. Sandy Bigelow Patterson. 5-18-73.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Who the hell is this?</dialogue>
    <character>DET. REILLY</character>
    <dialogue>If I had to guess, I'd say it's the woman who stole your identity. Obviously taking advantage of the fact that you have a girly name.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>It's not girly. It's unisex. So what is this-- like credit card fraud?</dialogue>
    <character>DET. REILLY</character>
    <dialogue>No, it's worse than that. They get a hold of your name, birth date, social security-- then they run up debt, get arrested, commit crimes-- as you. They tunnel into your life like a termite and rot you out from the inside until there's nothing left.</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>(claps his hands)</parenthetical>

    <parenthetical>(sweeps from high to low)</parenthetical>

    <parenthetical>(low to the ground)</parenthetical>

    <parenthetical>(rises)</parenthetical>

    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Jesus.</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>(writes on a pad)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>This is my new work contact info. Call me if you hear anything.</dialogue>

    <dialogue>I'll do that. In six months to a year.</dialogue>

My identity was stolen! Oh, I'm a liar now? You're calling me a LIAR? You know what? THIS IS WHY EVERYONE HATES BANKS! Get your manager!</dialogue>

Doesn't want to lose her. They approach an ELEVATED CAUSEWAY over marshy SWAMP. The only two cars visible for miles. DIANA accelerates more. SANDY keeps up. Until-- SCREEEE! Diana SLAMS ON HER BRAKES.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Shit!</dialogue>

  <scene>

    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>Ugh. My neck! Son of a bitch!</dialogue>

    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>There was a gopher in the road. OW, my spine!</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>

    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>All right. Yeah. Cool. Here.</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>(hands him her license)</parenthetical>

    <character>SANDY</character>
    <parenthetical>(reads her license)</parenthetical>

    <scene_description>She takes it. Looks at it. Sandy Bigelow Patterson. She slowly removes her hand from her neck. Straightens her posture. Looks back at Sandy like she's a different person. Then she PUNCHES him in the THROAT. Sandy drops like a dead man, still conscious, but gagging on his own throat. She tries to push past him into her car, but he BLOCKS HER ACCESS to the door while he tries to breathe. She runs and gets into HIS car. Starts it up. Backs up. Watching this, gasping for air, Sandy gets into HER car. Turns the key, but the engine won't turn over. Then: WHAM! He lurches forward into the steering wheel. Looks back. She's rammed HIS car into HER car. And now she's PUSHING her car, with him in it. To the edge of the causeway. He pushes the brake to the floor. HONKS the horn.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Hey! HEY!!!</dialogue>

Sandy flings the car door open and JUMPS OUT just before-- DIANA PUSHES HER OWN CAR OFF THE CAUSEWAY - it goes END over END over END and lands with a SPLASH in the SWAMPY MUCK. Sandy turns back and sees her GIVE HIM THE FINGER as she peels off in his rental. Stranding him. His phone rings. He answers, still finding his voice.</scene_description>

    <dialogue>Hello?</dialogue>
    <character>TRISH (ON PHONE)</character>

    <character>DEBT COLLECTOR (ON PHONE)</character>

    <dialogue>Yes, but--</dialogue>

Sandy opens the exposed passenger door. Crawls into her car. Opens the glove compartment. Nothing but the manual. Looks around. Sees: PINK PAPER wedged in the rear seat. He pulls it out. It's a BILL OF SALE for the car. Made out to Sandy Patterson. Goddammit. But below that... ...a Homestead, FL address.</scene_description>

    <scene_description>Prefab homes. Tiny lots. SANDY gets out of a cab. Walks toward DIANA'S HOUSE. The RENTAL CAR is in the driveway. And there's a goddamn MOTORBOAT parked on the lawn. DIANA - emerges from her house with a SUITCASE. Sees him. She drops the suitcase and RUNS back to the house. He CHASES, and just as she SLAMS THE DOOR, he jams an LEG in.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>AGGH!</dialogue>
    <scene_description>He pushes in after her, and she backs away over piles of: STUFF. The house is a HOARDER'S PARADISE. And the big yellow RAFT.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>

    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Here's the deal. We can do this the easy way, or the--</dialogue>
    <scene_description>She PUNCHES HIM IN THE THROAT. Again. He goes down. She tries to jump over him, but he GRABS HER LEG. She goes down, and they FIGHT. A SLOPPY, MESSY fight between two desperate people, neither of whom can afford to lose. He tries to HANDCUFF HER, but he can't pin her down. She rolls over him, smothering his face in her tits.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <parenthetical>(muffled)</parenthetical>
    <character>GARRR! GARRBARAARRRRR!!!!!</character>
    <dialogue>She's got her hand JAMMED in his pocket. CLENCHING. He roars in pain, wriggles free... and she BITES HIM on the leg.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>AGHHHH!!!</dialogue>
    <scene_description>He starts PUNCHING HER on the back of her head until her jaws RELEASE. They ROLL OVER, and now he's on top of her. Face to face. Sweaty. Her makeup is SMEARED. Breathing into each other's mouths. Close enough to kiss.</scene_description>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>Huh. Where's this going?</dialogue>
    <scene_description>He backs away, and she KNEES him in the chest, then bolts for the front door. Sandy grabs the RAFT OAR and FLINGS IT AT HER. It hits her in the back of the head, and she GOES DOWN. He staggers past her. Shuts the front door. Deadbolts it. Diana struggles to her feet, dazed. Holding the back of her head in pain. She flops down on her couch, winded. Sandy sees an overturned SHOE BOX on the floor. Spilling out of it are DRIVER'S LICENSES. All with Diana's picture. All different states. All different names. He grabs a handful.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>What is wrong with you? You're sick! Look at all this stuff. You don't even need it!</dialogue>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>Oh, you know me now?</dialogue>
    <scene_description>He sees FOUR GUITARS. He lifts one up.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Oh, okay. You play? I'd love to hear something. Or are these for your husband? No? Boyfriend?</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>(tosses the guitar)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Well there's a shock.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>That same flash of pain crosses her face. Sandy catches it. And even though she's ruined his life, he gets a guilty twinge. He was cruel, and he knows it.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>What's your name?</dialogue>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>Julie.</dialogue>
    <character>AVI (O.S.)</character>
    <dialogue>DIANA!!!</dialogue>

    <dialogue>How dare you? I choose to stay here at my pleasure, as do the hundreds of people I employ. I am the Senior Vice-President of Financial Management at the third largest personal investment firm in the world. I travel constantly, supervising hundreds of billions of dollars. This cost of this dinner is a molecule floating in an ocean. And you have the gall to question my company's ability or desire to pay it? Who do you think you are?</dialogue>
    <scene_description>The Maitre D' averts his eyes in submission.</scene_description>
    <character>MAITRE D'</character>
    <dialogue>I'm-- I'm so sorry. Of course.</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>(beaten down)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Please, accept my apologies. Allow me to host your wine for this evening.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Sandy nods his approval, like a warlord. The Maitre D' slinks off, tail between his legs. Sandy sits back down. Proud of himself. But Diana is suddenly uncomfortable.</scene_description>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>Wow.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Right?</dialogue>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>You were a little hard on him.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>You know what? The whole world's been hard on me. I don't want to be a chump anymore. You helped me see that.</dialogue>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>Did I.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Yeah, you messed up my life, but maybe it needed messing up. Maybe I needed a little more of you in me, you know? So thank you, Diana. No-- thank you whatever your real name is.</dialogue>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>That is my real name.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>No it's not. Come on. We're friends now. You can tell me.</dialogue>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>Fine. It's Marla.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Why are you lying?</dialogue>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>Who cares?</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>I care. I'd like to know one real thing about you. What's the big deal?</dialogue>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>I don't know. What is the big deal?</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Because you won't tell me.</dialogue>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>It doesn't matter.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Why won't you tell me your name?</dialogue>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>Because I don't want to.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Why?</dialogue>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>Because I don't know it!</dialogue>
    <scene_description>That stops him in his tracks.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>What about your family? What about Morganville, Kansas? That's all bullshit?</dialogue>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>No, there's a Morganville, Kansas. It's a nice town. It's real quaint. There's a little police station right there in the middle where people can come and leave babies they don't want. So which name would you like? I had six of them by the time I was through foster care.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>I'm sorry.</dialogue>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>I don't want your pity. I survived. I did what I had to.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Steal from people.</dialogue>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>Yeah, well-- who gives a shit about them? No one gives a fuck about me.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>That's not true.</dialogue>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>Oh yes it is. I'm alone. I've been alone every day of my life. Who's gonna get me a birthday present? Who's gonna take me on a trip? Who's gonna make me feel like I'm even here?</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>(in tears)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>I buy all this shit, it doesn't do me any fucking good. You think your girls want a big house, you think they want a rich daddy who pushes people around? You're so stupid. All I ever wanted was someone like you. Who was just there. Who cared. You want to be like me? You asshole. I want to be like you.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>She dries her face with a napkin.</scene_description>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>This makeup-- I'm never gonna be able to duplicate this--</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>(beat)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>I'm sorry. I didn't mean to tell you some lame dumpster baby story. It's all lies anyway. I'm a liar.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Sandy reaches out and takes her hand. She pulls her hand away. Goes back to her food.</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>INT. HOTEL ROOM - NIGHT</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Diana sleeps peacefully. Sandy watches her from the bedroom entrance, then quietly closes the door. He crosses to the desk, picks up the phone, and dials.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Hey, Bryan, it's a little before midnight. I'll be back in Boston late tomorrow night, in the office first thing the following morning.</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>(beat)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>About the woman...</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>(beat)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>I'll bring her in at nine AM. Let the police know.</dialogue>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. RICHMOND, VIRGINIA - EARLY MORNING</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Sun rises over Richmond.</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. PUBLIC PARKING LOT - MORNING</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Sandy and Diana walk to the El Camino. No one's around.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Did you go to the bathroom?</dialogue>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>I said I did.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Because it's straight shot today and we're not stopping for at least--</dialogue>
    <scene_description>As he opens the car, THE SKIPTRACER pops out from where he was curled up hiding in the front seat.</scene_description>
    <character>THE SKIPTRACER</character>
    <dialogue>Well, well, well.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>He's aiming a Taser X3 dart gun at Sandy. Nods back at the El Camino, proud of himself.</scene_description>
    <character>THE SKIPTRACER</character>
    <dialogue>Satellite radio. Got the serial number from the seller. Rest was easy.</dialogue>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>Damn. Are you Choctaw?</dialogue>
    <character>THE SKIPTRACER</character>
    <dialogue>No, I'm Polish.</dialogue>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>Cuz Choctaws are born trackers.</dialogue>
    <character>THE SKIPTRACER</character>
    <dialogue>Yeah? Well good for fuckin' them.</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>(to Sandy)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>You're the Sandy Patterson the agency wants. So turn around and walk slowly to that red car.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Please. Don't do this.</dialogue>
    <character>THE SKIPTRACER</character>
    <dialogue>Walk.</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>(to Diana)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>I don't need you. You can go.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Sandy turns and starts walking. Diana watches him. Free to leave if she wants. Then-- --she moves to stand between Sandy and The Skiptracer.</scene_description>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>You debt collectors are the scum of the earth, you know that? And I'm an identity thief, so-- seriously.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Sandy turns around. Can't believe she's doing this.</scene_description>
    <character>THE SKIPTRACER</character>
    <dialogue>This got nothin' to do with you.</dialogue>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>Yeah it does. He's my friend. You want him, you gotta go through me.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>The Skiptracer looks at the two of them. Then shrugs.</scene_description>
    <character>THE SKIPTRACER</character>
    <dialogue>Fine.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>He aims the gun, and-- BLAM! The shot echoes out across the parking lot. Diana and Sandy both FLINCH... but nothing happened. They're fine. Untouched. Wait-- "blam"? From a taser?</scene_description>
    <character>THE SKIPTRACER</character>
    <dialogue>OW! FUCK!</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Blood seeps through his shoulder. He's been shot.</scene_description>
    <character>VOICE (O.S.)</character>
    <dialogue>She belongs to us!</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Sandy and Diana turn to see: AVI AND ILAN walking toward them. Avi raises his gun to SHOOT her at close range, but Diana CHARGES and BITES HIS HAND.</scene_description>
    <character>AVI</character>
    <dialogue>AGHHH!</dialogue>
    <scene_description>He drops the gun. ILAN grabs Diana. THE SKIPTRACER grabs Sandy. Sandy and Diana instinctively GRAB EACH OTHER. Face to face. Clinging to one another for dear life-- --as the Israelis pull Diana one way and The Skiptracer pulls Sandy the other way.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Don't let go of me! Don't let go!</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Diana sees Avi struggle to his feet. Stumbling for his gun. She strains to get her mouth to Sandy's ear. WHISPERS SOMETHING IN HIS EAR His eyes go wide. Scared. Unsure. But she nods at him. You can do it.... Avi picks his gun up.</scene_description>
    <character>AVI</character>
    <dialogue>Diana!</dialogue>
    <scene_description>She gives Sandy one last smile. And then-- THEY LET GO Ilan and The Skiptracer each stumble backwards with their prey-- BLAM! - Avi MISSES HIS SHOT at her-- SANDY - spins around... and... PUNCHES THE SKIPTRACER IN THE THROAT. Perfect shot! The Skiptracer falls to the ground, gasping for air. Sandy grabs The Skiptracer's taser, turns, and-- FWIP! FWIP! Nails both of the Israelis right in their chests. They both drop to the ground, spasming in pain.</scene_description>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>DRIVE!</dialogue>
    <scene_description>They both jump in the El Camino and PEEL OUT. Diana CHUCKS SOMETHING out of the window as they drive away. It lands with a clatter between The Skiptracer, Avi and Ilan. The satellite radio. Avi struggles to barely sit up.</scene_description>
    <character>AVI</character>
    <dialogue>Who was that guy...?</dialogue>
    <scene_description>In the B.G., sirens. The police are on their way. Avi meets eyes with The Skiptracer, them slumps back to the ground. They both know-- it's over.</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. HIGHWAYS - DAY TO NIGHT</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>The El Camino rolls down the highway. One state turns to another. The sun sets, and the sky goes dark.</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. BOSTON - NIGHT</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>The El Camino rolls into town.</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>INT. SANDY'S APARTMENT - NIGHT</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>The door opens.</scene_description>
    <character>FRANNY AND JESSIE</character>
    <dialogue>DADDY!!!</dialogue>
    <scene_description>The girls run to his arms, and he hugs them like a man who almost died. Kisses them for all he's worth. Then sees Trish. Grabs her and kisses her. It's a lovely reunion. And then, Trish sees-- DIANA - waiting bashfully at the door. The girls turn and stare at her too.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Trish, Fran, Jessie-- this is Diana. She's going to stay with us, just for tonight.</dialogue>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>If that's okay.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>It's kind of mandatory.</dialogue>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>I just don't want to be any--</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>(to Trish)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>I know I caused you some trouble.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Trish is unmoved.</scene_description>
    <character>TRISH</character>
    <dialogue>You're welcome for the night. Girls, let's get dinner ready.</dialogue>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>INT. SANDY'S APARTMENT - LATER</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>They sit around the table, eating dinner. It's very strained.</scene_description>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>This is a really nice dinner, Mrs. Patterson.</dialogue>
    <character>TRISH</character>
    <dialogue>Thank you.</dialogue>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>I like how you decorated and everything.</dialogue>
    <character>TRISH</character>
    <dialogue>Mmm.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>More uncomfortable silence. The clicking of forks on plates, and little else. And then, through the wall: THUMP THUMP THUMP THUMP Derek and Kristi are screwing again. Sandy sighs. Puts his fork down. A reminder that he's back in Chump Town.</scene_description>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>Is that a frequent problem?</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Yeah.</dialogue>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>Excuse me for a second.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Diana gets up and walks out of the apartment. We hear footsteps down the hallway. Then a knock knock knock on the apartment next to them. Then some quiet talking. Then footsteps back. Diana walks back into Sandy's apartment, sits back down.</scene_description>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>You don't have that problem anymore.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>She starts eating. Calm. Cool. Supremely confident. Jessie stares at Diana like she's a superhero. Like Wonder Woman or something. Diana looks back at Jessie.</scene_description>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>Hey. You got some food on your face.</dialogue>
    <character>JESSIE</character>
    <dialogue>Where?</dialogue>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>Here.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Diana dabs a spot on her own face with a fork full of mashed potatoes. Leaves a big blotch. Jessie and Franny giggle.</scene_description>
    <character>JESSIE</character>
    <dialogue>No YOU have food on YOUR face!</dialogue>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>Where?</dialogue>
    <character>FRANNY AND JESSIE</character>
    <dialogue>THERE!</dialogue>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>Here?</dialogue>
    <scene_description>She dabs another spot above her eye.</scene_description>
    <character>FRANNY AND JESSIE</character>
    <dialogue>NO!</dialogue>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>Here?</dialogue>
    <character>FRANNY AND JESSIE</character>
    <dialogue>NO!!!!</dialogue>
    <scene_description>The girls are rolling with laughter</scene_description>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>I don't know what's going on. You guys are driving me crazy!</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Sandy looks over at Trish-- --and she's laughing. In spite of herself. He looks around the table. At his wife, his daughters, this strangest of guests... giggling and joyful and alive. The place doesn't seem so small anymore.</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>INT. SANDY'S APARTMENT - LATER</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Sandy tucks the girls in.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Okay, goodnight. No talking, okay? Right to bed.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>He turns to DIANA - on an air mattress on the floor.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>You sure you don't want to sleep on the couch?</dialogue>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>No way.</dialogue>
    <character>FRANNY</character>
    <dialogue>No way, daddy.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Okay. Well, goodnight.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>He turns the light off, and we follow him out as he closes the door behind him. He's about to walk off when:</scene_description>
    <character>JESSIE (O.S.)</character>
    <dialogue>Diana.</dialogue>
    <character>DIANA (O.S.)</character>
    <dialogue>Yeah?</dialogue>
    <character>JESSIE (O.S.)</character>
    <dialogue>You wanna give my doll a haircut?</dialogue>
    <character>DIANA (O.S.)</character>
    <dialogue>Yeah!</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Go to bed!</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Silence. Then:</scene_description>
    <character>DIANA (O.S.)</character>
    <parenthetical>(whispering)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Where are the scissors?</dialogue>
    <character>JESSIE (O.S.)</character>
    <parenthetical>(whispering)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>In my drawer.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>He lingers for a moment, listening as the girls whisper together. Decides to let them play.</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>INT. SANDY'S BEDROOM - HOURS LATER</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>He can't sleep. Looks over at the clock. 5:30 AM.</scene_description>
    <character>TRISH</character>
    <dialogue>Babe?</dialogue>
    <scene_description>He turns over to her, surprised she's awake.</scene_description>
    <character>TRISH</character>
    <dialogue>You okay?</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>She's going to go away for ten years.</dialogue>
    <character>TRISH</character>
    <dialogue>What else can you do?</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <parenthetical>(beat)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Your brother's always saying he could use help at the store. That's forty a year. Maybe.</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>(beat)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>What am I talking about? What's wrong with me?</dialogue>
    <scene_description>She cuddles up to him. Puts her arms around him.</scene_description>
    <character>TRISH</character>
    <dialogue>There's nothing wrong with you. Here. Feel. She's going crazy.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>She puts his hand on her belly.</scene_description>
    <character>TRISH</character>
    <dialogue>I know another kid wasn't part of your plan, but you backed me up. We always back each other up.</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>(beat)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Follow your heart, and I'll follow you.</dialogue>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>INT. BEDROOM - LATER</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>The door opens quietly. Sandy tiptoes in. The girls sleep peacefully. Jessie clutches a doll with a horrendous new haircut. Diana's covers lower and fall with her breath. Sandy kneels down to her. Nudges her with his hand.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>You have to go.</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>(beat)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Diana, the police are going to be there in the morning. Just go.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>No response. He shivers in the cold. Then notices: THE WINDOW is open. The curtains flutter. He pulls Diana's blanket back. It's the DOG under there. He crosses to the window. Looks out onto the FIRE ESCAPE just outside it. There's a NOTE on the sill. Sorry. --D He sits down on his girls' beanbag chair. Suddenly exhausted from the finality of it all. The journey is over. The verdict is rendered. No one ever changes. Not him. Not her.</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. BOSTON - MORNING</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>The sun rises over the city.</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. BOSTON STREET - MORNING</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>A crowd of busy people on their way to work. There, in the jumble of anonymous faces, is Sandy Patterson. Suit. Tie. On his way. But there's nothing good waiting for him where he's going.</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>INT. NEW CENTURY FINANCIAL - OFFICES - MORNING</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Ding. The elevator doors slide open. Sandy takes a breath, then makes the long walk down the hall, into:</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>INT. CONFERENCE ROOM - CONTINUOUS</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>The partners are seated around the table. Bryan at the head. Sandy stands. Clears his throat.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>I couldn't make it happen. To be honest, it wouldn't have happened anyway. Wasn't meant to be. Not for me. I'm sorry.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>He turns to leave.</scene_description>
    <character>BRYAN</character>
    <dialogue>Patterson?</dialogue>
    <scene_description>He turns back. Bryan points ACROSS THE HALL. Sandy turns, and we move with him as he walks out of the conference room, walks across the hall, walks into ANOTHER CONFERENCE ROOM, and now we see: COPS - and Detective Reilly - all sitting around the table. At the head of the table--</scene_description>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>Hey Sandy.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Reilly turns an AUDIO RECORDER off. Pockets it. Gets up.</scene_description>
    <character>DET. REILLY</character>
    <dialogue>That completes the statement process. You've been read your rights.</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>(to a cop)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Take her into custody.</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>(to Sandy)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Mr. Patterson? You're no longer a focus of this investigation. We'll be happy to provide your employer with a letter making that clear. Congratulations.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>He pats Sandy on the shoulder and heads out. A COP - puts handcuffs on Diana. Starts leading her out. Sandy watches her go. Too stunned to speak. Then follows...</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>INT. NEW CENTURY FINANCIAL - OFFICES - CONTINUOUS</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>As the cops lead her away...</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Wait. Can I have a second?</dialogue>
    <scene_description>The cop looks to Reilly, who nods. The police back off and give Diana and Sandy some space.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>I don't understand.</dialogue>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>C'mon, Sandy. I knew from the start this would end in cops. I figured I'd take advantage of the free ride until I felt like skipping out. The old hitch and ditch.</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>(beat)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>But--</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>(beat)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Hey, I've been a lot of people over the years. It's probably time to start being me. I can't do that on your back. I have to pay for what I've done.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>But why did you sneak out?</dialogue>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>Because if I stayed, you wouldn't have let me do this. Right?</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Sandy nods. She knows him. The true him.</scene_description>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>You're a good man, Sandy Patterson. And we are who we are.</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>(beat)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>I gotta go.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>As they lead her to the elevator...</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Thank you.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>She grins back at him through her tears.</scene_description>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>Huh. This feels pretty good!</dialogue>
    <scene_description>The elevator doors close. Bryan and the other partners gather around Sandy. Shake his hand. Walk him to his new office. He looks back one last time. But she's gone.</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. HOUSE - BACKYARD - ONE YEAR LATER - DAY</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Trish carries a BIRTHDAY CAKE out to the patio table, and sets it down in front of Sandy, who holds their new BABY.</scene_description>
    <character>TRISH/JESSIE/FRANNY</character>
    <dialogue>Happy birthday dear daddy... Happy birthday to you...</dialogue>
    <scene_description>He looks around. His wife, his girls, his baby. His new home, modest but his. His yard, his dog, his cake. "Happy 41st" He blows out the candles. Kisses Trish. Then checks his watch.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Ooh. We gotta get a move on.</dialogue>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>INT. PRISON VISITING ROOM - LATER</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>The Pattersons sit with DIANA in a family visiting room at the women's correctional facility. A guard stands outside. Diana plays "Sorry" with Franny and Jessie. Watches Trish rocking the baby to sleep.</scene_description>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>I can't get over how beautiful she is. You should've named her Diana, though.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Franny knocks one of Diana's pieces back to "start".</scene_description>
    <character>FRANNY</character>
    <dialogue>SORRY!!!</dialogue>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>Oh my God! I'm gonna kill you! I'm gonna shiv you in the yard, you hear me, new meat?</dialogue>
    <scene_description>The guard raps on the door from the outside.</scene_description>
    <character>PRISON GUARD (O.S.)</character>
    <dialogue>Two minutes.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Okay, real fast. Run it down for me.</dialogue>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>Math, A. Accounting, A.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Econ?</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <parenthetical>(off her look)</parenthetical>

    "summary":"In Denver, Sandy Patterson is tricked into buying phony identity theft protection from Diana, a Florida con artist, over the phone and he reveals all of his personal information. At work after Sandy clashes with his obnoxious boss, Harold Cornish, he receives a phone call that reminds him he has an appointment at a salon in Florida. Confused, he puts it out of his mind when co-worker Daniel Casey suggests they and several others leave Cornish and start their own firm. Sandy agrees to join them. When paying for gas, Sandy's credit card is declined, and the clerk cuts it up. As the credit card company tells him that he has spent thousands of dollars in Florida, he is arrested for missing a court date there. At the Denver police station, Detective Reilly determines Diana has stolen Sandy's identity. The situation worsens when cops ask Daniel, now his boss, about Sandy's alleged possession of drugs. Reilly says Sandy's name was used to buy drugs from someone named Paolo. When the cops say they can do nothing unless the identity thief is in Denver, Sandy offers to retrieve her and convince her to clear his name despite his wife's concerns. Sandy finds Diana at the salon in Winter Park, Florida, but when he confronts her, she steals his rental car. Finding her address in her abandoned car, he investigates her house, which is full of merchandise and stolen credit cards. The pair scuffle; before Sandy can handcuff her, criminals Marisol and Julian burst in, angry that Diana gave Paolo bad credit cards. After Sandy and Diana escape, Sandy tells her about his plan to restore his reputation, and she agrees to help. Meanwhile, a skiptracer is dispatched to track down Diana for a substantial bounty. Because their IDs are identical, flight is impossible, and they travel by car. After traveling through several states, the skiptracer catches up to the pair and captures Diana. A chase ensues; she knocks him unconscious, and Sandy rams his van off the road. They take the skiptracer's van and tie him up in back. When it overheats, they continue on foot through a forest. Sandy discards his pants when he finds a snake in them, and Diana accidentally knocks him unconscious when another bites his neck. Sandy wakes at a bus station, and Diana says she carried him until she flagged down a truck. As the next bus to Denver leaves in three days, Sandy uses money hidden in his socks to buy a $200 car. For gas money, the pair con an accounts processor and steal Cornish's identity to create new credit cards. Meanwhile, Marisol shoots the skiptracer, and the criminals continue their pursuit of Sandy and Diana. In St. Louis, the two share dinner, and Diana admits she does not know her real name. The accounts processor enters with cops, who arrest Sandy and Diana. Diana uncuffs herself in the back of the police car, breaks the back windshield, and escapes with Sandy. The skiptracer shoots Marisol and Julian, finds Diana and Sandy on the highway mid-escape, and hits Diana with his car. Sandy comes to her aid, but Diana revives and defensively strikes Sandy in the throat. As Sandy and Diana escape, the skiptracer is arrested by the police alongside Marisol and Julian. Diana and Sandy eventually get home where Diana has dinner with Sandy's family and reconciles with them. Sandy and Trish have a private conversation that night, agreeing not to turn in Diana even if it means that Sandy will lose his job. The next morning, Sandy finds Diana gone and a note that apologizes for the trouble she caused. Sandy prepares to quit his job, but Daniel shows him that Diana is meeting with the police in an office. Detective Reilly tells Sandy he is no longer part of the investigation, and Diana is taken away in cuffs. Before she leaves, Sandy asks her why; Diana says she knew he would not turn her in, but it was the right thing to do. One year later, Sandy celebrates another birthday, this time with his third child. The family visits Diana in prison, and Sandy presents her with a birth certificate that reveals her name as Dawn Budgie. Diana hugs Sandy. When a guard antagonizes her, Diana punches the guard, and another guard stuns her with a Taser. As she recovers and walks back to her cell, Sandy watches with a shocked expression."
