    <dialogue>This is kind of embarrassing but I have to get up and pee a lot at night. I have an enlarged prostate.</dialogue>
    <character>RICKI</character>
    <dialogue>That's all right. I--</dialogue>
    <scene_description>She pauses, debating whether or not she should confess something similar.</scene_description>
    <character>RICKI (CONT'D)</character>
    <dialogue>I have to put in an estrogen suppository before bed.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Greg doesn't seem put off in the least.</scene_description>
    <character>GREG</character>
    <dialogue>Huh. This stuff is fun, right?</dialogue>
    <scene_description>He extends a hand to Ricki and helps her get out of bed.</scene_description>
    <character>RICKI</character>
    <dialogue>Oh yeah. It's a blast.</dialogue>
    <character>GREG</character>
    <dialogue>Rock and roll.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Greg heads off to the tiny bathroom as Ricki throws on her robe. MUSIC UP: CLASSIC ROCK BEGIN MONTAGE We see VARIOUS SCENES of Ricki returning to her usual life, building her relationship with Greg, working, playing...etc.</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>INT. WHOLE FOODS - MORNING</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Ricki rings up a mountain of overpriced PRODUCE for a bored STAY-AT-HOME MOM. A THREE-YEAR-OLD GIRL grabs an expensive bar of "rainforest chocolate" off the conveyor and unwraps it. Ricki smiles at the little girl, who stares back at her rudely. Ricki totals out the groceries...$366.00. Ricki's teenaged MANAGER walks by and gives her an approving nod.</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>INT. REHEARSAL - DAY</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Ricki and the Flash rehearse in BUSTER'S GARAGE. Ricki, in glasses and jeans, is playing RHYTHM GUITAR and singing her heart out. There's a hiccup and Joe stops playing drums. The band convenes for a brief discussion. They're a welloiled machine. Joe counts off with his sticks again, and they're off...</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>INT. SHAKEY'S BUFFET - DAY</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Date night at a cheap BUFFET RESTAURANT. Ricki carries her plate of food over to a booth. Greg, who is already seated, has taken full advantage of the all-you-can-eat "snow crab" situation. His overflowing plate of TEENY-TINY CRAB LEGS is adorable. Despite the terrible food and the cheap carnation in a vase, it's...romantic.</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>INT. SALT WELL - NIGHT</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Ricki CLIMBS ON THE BAR, her signature move. She struts past the Trivia Touch machines mounted on the bar. There's about 30 people in the bar, but the Flash is giving it their usual 110%. Onstage, Greg is a sweaty rock beast. Daniel whips out his BAR RAG and discreetly mops Ricki's footprints off the bar. Gazing at his idol, he pretends to wring the rag into a GLASS and drink it.</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>INT. RICKI'S APARTMENT (BEDROOM) - NIGHT</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Ricki and Greg are lying in bed together. Ricki has her glasses on and is reading a BOOK. Greg, also wearing glasses reads the latest issue of Rolling Stone. Greg suddenly flings the magazine aside and "attacks" her playfully. Their glasses knock together as they make out.</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>INT. RICKI'S APARTMENT (LIVING ROOM) - DAY</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Alone, Ricki enters carrying a big pile of MAIL. She tosses aside the junk, the piles of collection notices and bills. Then she notices a curiously large MANILA ENVELOPE. She immediately recognizes the return address: Feather Drive, Naperville, Illinois. Pete's house. END SONG Cautiously, Ricki opens the envelope. There's a slightly smaller, SQUARE ENVELOPE inside; it has an expensive, creamy look to it. There's also a HANDWRITTEN LETTER. Ricki reads the letter first. We hear MAUREEN'S VOICE narrating as we read along.</scene_description>
    <character>MAUREEN (V.O.)</character>
    <dialogue>Dear Linda. I'm sorry about some of the words we exchanged during your visit. As you know, it's a loaded topic and we haven't had many chances to talk about it. Please accept this olive branch from me, and I hope we can try again on better terms.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Ricki reflects, then reads on:</scene_description>
    <character>MAUREEN (V.O.)</character>
    <dialogue>Also, I heard that you poured beer on that bitch Nicole from Traffic. Respect. I wish I had been there.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Ricki grins at the memory.</scene_description>
    <character>MAUREEN (V.O.)</character>
    <dialogue>Enclosed, please find something I feel you should have received a long time ago. You're entitled to it. Hope to see you in a few weeks. Maureen.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Ricki opens up the fancy envelope. It's an engraved INVITATION, with a rustic-yet-expensive look. It's tied together with a piece of GREEN TWINE. The invite reads: Mr. and Mrs. Jonathan Schmitz request the honor of your presence at the marriage of their daughter Emily Anne Schmitz to Joshua Hendrix Brummel.</scene_description>
    <character>RICKI</character>
    <dialogue>Joshy.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>She sifts through the different components of the fancy invite. There's a card that says: Dinner Choice: Vegan/Gluten Free\_\_\_ Vegetarian\_\_ And finally one last little SLIP OF PAPER included with the invitation. We hear EMILY'S girlish voice read it aloud.</scene_description>
    <character>EMILY (V.O.)</character>
    <dialogue>This invitation is embedded with wildflower seeds and can be planted! Please return it to the earth!</dialogue>
    <scene_description>This gets an eye-roll from Ricki. But we can see that the invite, even coming from Maureen, means the world to her.</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>INT. SALT WELL - EVENING</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>The Salt Well is decorated for Valentine's Day. Ricki is sitting at the BAR, drinking a glass of wine. Daniel is reading the INVITATION, which Ricki has brought to show him. The Flash is doing a routine SOUND CHECK on the stage as people filter into the bar.</scene_description>
    <character>DANIEL</character>
    <parenthetical>(reading)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>"In lieu of a gift, please make a donation to one of the following children's charities."</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>(aghast)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Ha! Oh my God, who gets married and doesn't want a bunch of stuff?</dialogue>
    <character>RICKI</character>
    <dialogue>My son.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>On stage, Buster speaks into the mic.</scene_description>
    <character>BUSTER</character>
    <dialogue>Testes, one-two.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Daniel hands the invite back to Ricki.</scene_description>
    <character>DANIEL</character>
    <dialogue>Flower seeds. That is some bougie shit. How much do you think those invites cost per person?</dialogue>
    <character>RICKI</character>
    <dialogue>I have no idea. I just thought you'd get a kick out of it.</dialogue>
    <character>DANIEL</character>
    <dialogue>So are you excited about the wedding, then?</dialogue>
    <character>RICKI</character>
    <dialogue>I'm not going.</dialogue>
    <character>DANIEL</character>
    <dialogue>You have to! It won't be sexy without you. Buy something at Dress Barn, take your man, and go see your baby get married.</dialogue>
    <character>RICKI</character>
    <dialogue>I don't have any money. I discussed it with Greg and we simply don't have it. But it's fine. I don't think I'm necessarily wanted there.</dialogue>
    <character>DANIEL</character>
    <dialogue>Well, you're always wanted here.</dialogue>
    <character>RICKI</character>
    <dialogue>Thank you, sweetie.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Ricki pats Daniel's hand as she gets up and heads for the stage. She hops on to scattered applause.</scene_description>
    <character>RICKI</character>
    <dialogue>Good evening, Tarzana! Happy Valentine's weekend to all you lovers out there. Any Janis fans out there? Janis Joplin?</dialogue>
    <scene_description>No response, except CLAPPING from Daniel.</scene_description>
    <character>RICKI (CONT'D)</character>
    <dialogue>Good, because we're gonna start things off with a song that's very special to me...</dialogue>
    <scene_description>She glances at Greg, who is wearing a DIFFERENT GUITAR than usual. It's not his beautiful sunburst Gibson SG. It's a cheaper YELLOW ELECTRIC GUITAR, '80s model.</scene_description>
    <character>RICKI (CONT'D)</character>
    <dialogue>Where's your guitar?</dialogue>
    <character>GREG</character>
    <dialogue>This is my guitar.</dialogue>
    <character>RICKI</character>
    <dialogue>No, your guitar.</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>(disbelief)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Your '68 SG Standard that you've been besotted with since the day I met you?</dialogue>
    <character>GREG</character>
    <dialogue>I felt like playing this one tonight.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>This idea is so absurd that Ricki laughs.</scene_description>
    <character>RICKI</character>
    <dialogue>Yeah, right. The "Wet Banana"? What's going on?</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Billy, Buster and Joe exchange glances.</scene_description>
    <character>GREG</character>
    <dialogue>I sold it.</dialogue>
    <character>RICKI</character>
    <dialogue>Why?</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Greg just looks at her. Over on bass, Buster shakes his head and takes a drag off his blue e-cigarette.</scene_description>
    <character>RICKI</character>
    <dialogue>Oh, Greg.</dialogue>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>INT. AIRPORT (SECURITY CHECKPOINT) - DAY</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Ricki and Greg are the TSA's worst nightmare. Greg pulls off a GIANT BELT BUCKLE and unlaces a pair of 18-hole boots. Ricki is removing her usual array of accessories.</scene_description>
    <character>GREG</character>
    <dialogue>How do we know that scanner isn't some form of mind-control?</dialogue>
    <character>TSA AGENT</character>
    <dialogue>Sir, you cannot take this through.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>An AGENT, digging through Greg's carry-on, holds up a bottle of CABO WABO TEQUILA.</scene_description>
    <character>GREG</character>
    <dialogue>Come on, man, that's Sammy Hagar's tequila!</dialogue>
    <character>TSA AGENT #2</character>
    <parenthetical>(to Ricki)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Ma'am, I need you to remove the toe ring.</dialogue>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>INT. PLANE - DAY</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Ricki and Greg READ on the plane. Ricki is reading a library copy of The Celestine Prophecy. Greg enthusiastically flips through the Skymall catalog.</scene_description>
    <character>GREG</character>
    <dialogue>Look at this. It cooks the hot dog and toasts the bun at the same time.</dialogue>
    <character>RICKI</character>
    <dialogue>That's useful.</dialogue>
    <character>GREG</character>
    <dialogue>Right?</dialogue>
    <character>RICKI</character>
    <dialogue>This book is very enlightening.</dialogue>
    <character>GREG</character>
    <parenthetical>(musing)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>I don't eat hot dogs much anymore.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Ricki pats Greg's arm affectionately.</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. DRESS BARN (TO ESTABLISH) - DAY</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>A strip mall in the Chicago suburbs.</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>INT. DRESS BARN - DAY</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Ricki is in one of the "dressing rooms"-- a BOOTH hidden behind a curtain. Greg is sitting on a chair waiting for her to emerge.</scene_description>
    <character>GREG</character>
    <dialogue>Come out, babe.</dialogue>
    <character>RICKI (O.S.)</character>
    <dialogue>I look absurd.</dialogue>
    <character>GREG</character>
    <dialogue>I'm sure you look gorgeous.</dialogue>
    <character>RICKI (O.S.)</character>
    <dialogue>I look like my mother.</dialogue>
    <character>GREG</character>
    <dialogue>No way. Your mother's dead.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Ricki comes out wearing a CONSERVATIVE, UN-RICKI-LIKE PALE BLUE DRESS with the tags hanging off it. It looks very odd with her pleather boots.</scene_description>
    <character>GREG</character>
    <dialogue>You look beautiful. That is like, the most amazing blue. Reminds me of Roger Daltrey's eyes in Tommy.</dialogue>
    <character>RICKI</character>
    <parenthetical>(sincere)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Thank you.</dialogue>
    <character>GREG</character>
    <dialogue>Did the invitation say you had to be fancy?</dialogue>
    <character>RICKI</character>
    <dialogue>It said "Dress to Impress." Ricki rolls her eyes at the affected wording.</dialogue>
    <character>GREG</character>
    <dialogue>Well, I'm impressed.</dialogue>
    <character>RICKI</character>
    <dialogue>I haven't seen a lot of these people in years. Pete got "custody" of all our friends and most of the family. They're gonna see me and there's gonna say "Wow, there's Linda. I guess things didn't work out for her in Hollywood."</dialogue>
    <character>GREG</character>
    <dialogue>Um, are any of those "nosy rosies" in Tarzana's number one party band?</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Ricki has to laugh at that.</scene_description>
    <character>GREG</character>
    <dialogue>Yeah. I'd say things worked out pretty fucking well!</dialogue>
    <character>RICKI</character>
    <dialogue>Ha. I'll just tell them I'm collaborating with Greg Sandoval. That'll shut them up.</dialogue>
    <character>GREG</character>
    <dialogue>Collaborating? You're doing him. You're the luckiest woman alive.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>The SALES LADY walks over.</scene_description>
    <character>SALES LADY</character>
    <dialogue>Can I show you some other styles?</dialogue>
    <character>RICKI</character>
    <dialogue>Do you have anything black?</dialogue>
    <character>GREG</character>
    <dialogue>She'll take this one.</dialogue>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. MORTON ARBORETUM (TO ESTABLISH) - DAY</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>It's a beautiful spring day at the OUTDOOR WEDDING VENUE, a tree-filled nature preserve.</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. MORTON ARBORETUM - DAY</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>A HARPIST plays as GUESTS filter into the WEDDING CEREMONY. HIP-LOOKING WAITERS and WAITRESSES hold trays of signature COCKTAILS. The wedding looks perfectly rustic in a very expensive way. Ricki enters the area with trepidation, wearing her new blue dress. A PERKY WAITRESS immediately solicits her.</scene_description>
    <character>WAITRESS</character>
    <dialogue>Would you like a cocktail before the ceremony?</dialogue>
    <character>RICKI</character>
    <dialogue>Sure. What is this?</dialogue>
    <character>WAITRESS</character>
    <parenthetical>(gesturing)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>This one is called "The Josh." It's ginger beer and small-batch whiskey with candied lemon peel. This is "The Emily"; it's kind of a playful take on a Kir Royale.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Ricki looks at the girl like she's speaking Cantonese.</scene_description>
    <character>RICKI</character>
    <dialogue>Which one do you recommend?</dialogue>
    <character>WAITRESS</character>
    <dialogue>Sorry, I'm in recovery.</dialogue>
    <character>RICKI</character>
    <dialogue>Me too.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Ricki scoots away from the cocktails, wrinkling her nose. She wanders self-consciously through the sea of assembled GUESTS. Suddenly, a WIZENED HAND grips her arm.</scene_description>
    <character>OMA (O.S.)</character>
    <dialogue>Linda.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Linda turns to see a VERY OLD WOMAN of about 90.</scene_description>
    <character>RICKI</character>
    <dialogue>Hi, Oma. How are you?</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Oma appears to be senile.</scene_description>
    <character>OMA</character>
    <dialogue>I like you. You know? Even though you ran off on my son.</dialogue>
    <character>RICKI</character>
    <dialogue>I always liked you too.</dialogue>
    <character>OMA</character>
    <dialogue>How is Las Vegas?</dialogue>
    <character>RICKI</character>
    <dialogue>Um...</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>(realizing)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Los Angeles. It's very nice. Warm.</dialogue>
    <character>OMA</character>
    <dialogue>I don't like Peter's new wife one bit. Don't trust her.</dialogue>
    <character>RICKI</character>
    <dialogue>Peter and Maureen seem happy.</dialogue>
    <character>OMA</character>
    <dialogue>Maybe now, but it's only been a few weeks.</dialogue>
    <character>RICKI</character>
    <parenthetical>(gently)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>It's been many years.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>A YOUNG, MALE RELATIVE rushes to retrieve poor, confused Oma.</scene_description>
    <character>MALE RELATIVE</character>
    <dialogue>Oma, there you are! Come on. Let's have a seat.</dialogue>
    <character>MALE RELATIVE</character>
    <parenthetical>(to Ricki, flat)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Oh. Hi.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Oma is ushered away. Ricki looks at the COCKTAIL WAITRESS.</scene_description>
    <character>RICKI</character>
    <dialogue>I'll take "the Emily."</dialogue>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. MORTON ARBORETUM (CEREMONY AREA) - DAY</stage_direction>
    <character>OFFICIANT (O.S.)</character>
    <dialogue>Everyone, please take your seats.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>The ceremony is about to start. The ceremony area consists of about 100 chairs in a clearing. Everything is festooned with wildflowers. Ricki is seated alone on an aisle seat near the back, reading the wedding program. The "better" seats are rapidly filling up. As PEOPLE walk by and sit down, we hear a snippet of GOSSIP in hushes tones: Is that?...It is. Wow...Not even sitting with family... Ricki continues to look down at her program.</scene_description>
    <character>OFFICIANT</character>
    <dialogue>All rise.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Everyone complies. Ricki looks ahead and sees that JOSH and ADAM, the best man, have appeared at the altar in suits. A CLASSICAL GUITARIST begins to play near the altar as the wedding procession begins. A BRIDESMAID in a long dress walks down the aisle, escorted by a GROOMSMAN. Another PAIR follows. The bridesmaids wear elegant vintage dresses and carry "green" bouquets. Then, Julie appears, looking radiant (and almost unrecognizable) with her hair and makeup done. She's so beautiful that there's a murmur through the crowd as she emerges on the arm of a GROOMSMAN Julie sees Ricki and pauses. Ricki smiles at Julie. Julie looks at the assembled crowd, remembering her last trip down the aisle. She looks frozen, disturbed. Ricki realizes what's bothering Julie. As the GROOMSMAN tries to nudge Julie down the aisle, Ricki leans over and whispers at her daughter.</scene_description>
    <character>RICKI</character>
    <dialogue>Don't run away.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Julie looks back at her mother.</scene_description>
    <character>RICKI</character>
    <dialogue>Just keep walking.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>She nods encouragingly. Julie looks ahead, squares her shoulders, continues to WALK. As Ricki regards Julie's departing form, she notices with surprise-- and love-- that her daughter wears COMBAT BOOTS with her dress. Finally, EMILY appears, escorted by both her MOTHER and FATHER. All three look rich, elegant and happy. Shutters click as everybody oohs and ahhs over the bride. Ricki looks at Josh: he wipes a tear away from his eye as he gazes at his soon-to-be wife. Ricki looks at the bride and her parents as they stride past her: a perfect, intact TRIAD, seemingly untouched by dysfunction or pain. From the front row, PETE and MAUREEN beam at their soon-to- be daughter-in-law. Pete's arm is around Maureen. He rubs her arm happily as the bride swishes past. Ricki glances across the aisle at a LITTLE BOY who seems to be having an awful time. He pouts and kicks the chair in front of him. He meets Ricki's gaze. She WINKS.</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>INT. RECEPTION - DAY</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Ricki makes her way through the RECEIVING LINE, where Josh and Emily greet their GUESTS. Josh hugs Ricki warmly, overwhelmed by his big day.</scene_description>
    <character>JOSH</character>
    <dialogue>Mom. I'm so glad you're here. I didn't know if you would make it out.</dialogue>
    <character>RICKI</character>
    <dialogue>My boyfriend pawned his Gibson SG.</dialogue>
    <character>EMILY</character>
    <dialogue>Oh!</dialogue>
    <character>JOSH</character>
    <dialogue>Well, we got your RSVP so late that we couldn't really move things around with the hall so...</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>(awkward)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>I hope you don't mind eating with some of Emily's cousins and like, our harpist...</dialogue>
    <character>RICKI</character>
    <dialogue>Not at all. I'd love to learn about harp theory. Well. I'll see you guys in there.</dialogue>
    <character>EMILY</character>
    <dialogue>Great.</dialogue>
    <character>JOSH</character>
    <dialogue>Really great to see you, Mom.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Ricki heads into the reception area and sees ADAM with his date, a GOOD-LOOKING ASIAN GUY. She waves in their direction.</scene_description>
    <character>RICKI</character>
    <dialogue>Adam!</dialogue>
    <scene_description>She trots toward them and holds her arms out expectantly. Adam puts on a brave face. So does Ricki.</scene_description>
    <character>ADAM</character>
    <dialogue>Hi, Mom. Um, Desmond, this is my mother, Linda.</dialogue>
    <character>DESMOND</character>
    <dialogue>What a pleasure. I see where Adam gets his cheekbones.</dialogue>
    <character>RICKI</character>
    <dialogue>You're Adam's friend?</dialogue>
    <character>DESMOND</character>
    <parenthetical>(quickly)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Yes. We're friends.</dialogue>
    <character>ADAM</character>
    <dialogue>We're seeing each other.</dialogue>
    <character>RICKI</character>
    <dialogue>That's wonderful. Adam, I'm so glad you've met someone. Particularly someone so handsome! You may be too young for this, but have you ever heard of Bruce Lee?</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Adam looks like he wants to die.</scene_description>
    <character>DESMOND</character>
    <dialogue>Of course I've heard of Bruce Lee; he's the man!</dialogue>
    <character>RICKI</character>
    <dialogue>You look a lot like him.</dialogue>
    <character>ADAM</character>
    <dialogue>Not at all. Not even a little.</dialogue>
    <character>DESMOND</character>
    <dialogue>Thanks! I've been growing my hair out lately, and I think I'm serving up some "Bruce realness."</dialogue>
    <character>ADAM</character>
    <dialogue>You're not even Chinese.</dialogue>
    <character>DESMOND</character>
    <dialogue>Neither was Bruce; he was born in San Francisco.</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>(to Ricki)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>I did a research paper on him in college.</dialogue>
    <character>RICKI</character>
    <dialogue>Where did you go to school?</dialogue>
    <character>DESMOND</character>
    <dialogue>Harvard.</dialogue>
    <character>RICKI</character>
    <parenthetical>(enjoying herself)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Wow! Adam always dreamed of going to Harvard, but to no avail...</dialogue>
    <character>ADAM</character>
    <dialogue>Thanks, Mom.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Ricki stops and looks Adam in the eyes.</scene_description>
    <character>RICKI</character>
    <dialogue>No. You're brilliant. If you'd had more support from me, you could have done it.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Adam seems to respect Ricki's willingness to "own" this.</scene_description>
    <character>ADAM</character>
    <dialogue>Thanks.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Desmond's eyes dart from Ricki to Adam. Awkward.</scene_description>
    <character>RICKI</character>
    <dialogue>Well. I just think you two are a beautiful couple and I hope you have a nice time and enjoy your vegan dinner.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>She pronounces it vedge-in, like vegetable.</scene_description>
    <character>ADAM</character>
    <dialogue>Vegan.</dialogue>
    <character>RICKI</character>
    <dialogue>I don't know what it is.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>She smiles and walks off. Adam's got that stun-gun look.</scene_description>
    <character>ADAM</character>
    <parenthetical>(to Desmond)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>OK, she must be heavily medicated.</dialogue>
    <character>DESMOND</character>
    <dialogue>I like her.</dialogue>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>INT. RECEPTION - EVENING</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>The dinner portion of the RECEPTION is in full swing. Everything is lovely, quirky, and just-so. Guests drink wine out of mason jars. A JAZZ COMBO plays dinner music onstage. Near the front of the room, the BRIDAL PARTY holds court at the customary LONG TABLE. Pete is sitting there, chatting with the newlyweds. The seat next to him is empty; Maureen is circulating and saying hello to various people. The perfect hostess. Ricki watches her, as usual, with envy. Near the back of the room, Ricki is sitting at a round table with SEVEN OTHER PEOPLE, none of whom she knows. A GIRL sitting across from her tries to strike up a conversation</scene_description>
    <character>GIRL AT TABLE</character>
    <dialogue>So, how did you meet Josh?</dialogue>
    <character>RICKI</character>
    <dialogue>Caesarean section.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Before the confused girl can reply. Ricki glances at her watch nervously.</scene_description>
    <character>RICKI</character>
    <dialogue>I have to go.</dialogue>

    <scene_description>Cornish laughs with Larry. Sandy forces himself to join in. But he's dying inside. Cornish points to the forms.</scene_description>

    <dialogue>Go ahead and stamp.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Of course. I'll just need a valid form of ID... driver's license?</dialogue>

    <parenthetical>(to Cornish)</parenthetical>

    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Oh. Um-- I do need to see it.</dialogue>
    <character>LARRY BIRD</character>
    <dialogue>I just told you, I don't have it.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Maybe you could run down and get it?</dialogue>
    <character>CORNISH</character>
    <dialogue>Are you out of your mind?</dialogue>
    <character>LARRY BIRD</character>
    <dialogue>Are you saying I'm not Larry Bird?</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>No, of course not! But I took a public oath. I can't notarize a document without confirming ID.</dialogue>
    <character>CORNISH</character>
    <dialogue>His FACE is his ID, you jackass!</dialogue>
    <character>LARRY BIRD</character>
    <dialogue>I'm Larry Bird!</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>I know! But the rules-- !</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Larry Bird stands up. Furious.</scene_description>
    <character>LARRY BIRD</character>
    <dialogue>I am six foot nine! This is BOSTON!</dialogue>
    <character>CORNISH</character>
    <dialogue>Stamp it, Patterson!</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Larry Bird grabs for the stamp. Sandy clutches it to his chest, frightened.</scene_description>
    <character>LARRY BIRD</character>
    <dialogue>I AM LARRY BIRD! I AM THE GREATEST</dialogue>
    <character>OF ALL TIME! STAMP IT!</character>
    <dialogue>CORNISH</dialogue>
    <character>STAMP IT!</character>
    <dialogue>LARRY BIRD</dialogue>
    <character>STAMP IT! STAMP IT!</character>
    <dialogue>SANDY</dialogue>

  <scene>
    <stage_direction>INT. SANDY'S OFFICE - CONTINUOUS</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Sandy slumps back into his office, sits down. Hot with shame. Something good will happen today. He CRUMPLES the note up and throws it out. His PHONE RINGS, startling him. He answers. No longer chipper.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>This is Sandy Patterson.</dialogue>
    <character>CALLER (ON PHONE)</character>
    <dialogue>Yes, Sandy? I'm Jeanette with Lady's Choice salon confirming your appointment for this Wednesday at three?</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>I'm sorry, you have the wrong number.</dialogue>
    <character>CALLER (ON PHONE)</character>
    <dialogue>Sandy Bigelow Patterson?</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Odd. His middle name. That gets his attention.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Yes, but--</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>(checks the caller ID)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Where are you calling from?</dialogue>
    <character>CALLER (ON PHONE)</character>
    <dialogue>Homestead, Florida.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>I'm in Boston. How did you get this number?</dialogue>
    <character>CALLER (ON PHONE)</character>
    <dialogue>You didn't leave one when you made the appointment, so we Googled you.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Well, I'm sorry, but you have the wrong person.</dialogue>
    <character>CALLER (ON PHONE)</character>
    <dialogue>Are you sure?</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>You're Lady's Choice in Florida. I'm a man in Massachusetts.</dialogue>
    <character>CALLER (ON PHONE)</character>
    <dialogue>So you're not Sandy Patterson?</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>No! I'm no one! GOODBYE!</dialogue>

    <character>BRYAN</character>
    <dialogue>We need to talk.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Oh no.</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>INT. EMERGENCY STAIRWELL - OFFICE BUILDING - MOMENTS LATER</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Bryan enters the stairwell. Stonefaced. Sandy follows.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Bryan, you gotta understand, this Larry Bird thing wasn't my--</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Sandy stops. Bryan's there, but so are THREE OTHER GUYS. All in expensive suits. All around 30. All looking at him.</scene_description>
    <character>BRYAN</character>
    <dialogue>We're leaving Prominence.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <parenthetical>(stunned)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>You guys book half the business here.</dialogue>
    <character>BRYAN</character>
    <dialogue>We know. And if it were up to Cornish, we'd be sucking his ass for the rest of our lives. That's why we're starting our own firm, and we're taking all of our clients with us.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Jesus-- that's a four billion dollar portfolio...</dialogue>
    <character>BRYAN</character>
    <dialogue>Five. Come with us.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Sandy is floored. Him?</scene_description>
    <character>BRYAN</character>
    <dialogue>You're the best at what you do. You'll be a junior partner. Run the back office, plus a piece of the business. What are you making now?</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Fifty.</dialogue>
    <character>BRYAN</character>
    <dialogue>You're gonna make fifty next month.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Oh my god. When is this happening?</dialogue>
    <character>BRYAN</character>
    <dialogue>Now.</dialogue>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>INT. OFFICE AREA - CONTINUOUS</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Bryan and his partners stride out to the middle of the floor, amidst the cubicles and offices. Sandy follows, hanging back, as Bryan picks up a STAPLER and BANGS ON THE WALL, getting everyone's attention. He steps up and stands on a desk.</scene_description>
    <character>BRYAN</character>
    <dialogue>The four of us are leaving to start a new company.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>He raises his Blackberry and presses a button.</scene_description>
    <character>BRYAN</character>
    <dialogue>You now have our new contact info.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Everyone stops. You can hear a pin drop. This is nuclear.</scene_description>
    <character>BRYAN</character>
    <dialogue>We will need secretaries. Clerks. IT. You can submit applications on--</dialogue>
    <character>CORNISH</character>
    <dialogue>NOBODY MOVE.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Cornish stands across the way. Addresses the troops.</scene_description>
    <character>CORNISH</character>
    <dialogue>Anyone who stays right where they are gets a 5% raise, here and now.</dialogue>
    <character>CORNISH</character>
    <dialogue>Anyone who moves-- will regret it. This firm has offices in twenty cities across five continents. You don't want us for an enemy.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Sandy takes that in. The raise. The threat. SECURITY grabs hold of the four rebels.</scene_description>
    <character>BRYAN</character>
    <dialogue>Last chance. Who's with us?</dialogue>
    <scene_description>The room is dead silent. No one moves. Cornish gloats.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>I am.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Cornish looks around, searching for the traitor.</scene_description>
    <character>CORNISH</character>
    <dialogue>Who said that?</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <parenthetical>(petrified)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>I did.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Cornish stares in disbelief and fury at Sandy. As security marches him out with Bryan and the others--</scene_description>
    <character>CORNISH</character>
    <dialogue>You better pray this works out, Patterson, because I'm killing you everywhere else! No one will hire you! Not here, not anywhere! You hear me? You're a dead man! In this town, in this business! Everywhere you go! WHO DO YOU THINK YOU ARE? WHO DO YOU THINK YOU ARE???</dialogue>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>INT. SHOPPING MALL - FLORIDA - SAME TIME</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Diana rides up the escalator, drinking an Orange Julius, talking on a crappy cell phone.</scene_description>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>Of course I appreciate it. Yes. Ugh, fine. "Thank you for bailing me out, Moshe." I don't know. Figure two weeks. I'll be done in an hour, and then it's all yours. Okay?</dialogue>
    <scene_description>As she steps off the elevator, the phone goes BOOP. Call dropped. She casually TOSSES the phone into a TRASH BIN. IN THE JEWELRY STORE She points a ring out to the saleswoman. Credit card in hand.</scene_description>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>That one looks great. Lost my wedding ring. Can you believe it? Fifteen years. He's a big stockbroker. But it's not about stuff, you know? It's about partnership.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>AUNTIE ANNE'S PRETZELS Diana stuffs an entire cinnamon sugar pretzel in her mouth. Talks to the cashier through a wad of dough.</scene_description>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>Mmm. Low blood sugar. It's working. This is very fresh.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>COSMETICS COUNTER The salesgirl SWIPES the card. Diana shows off her new ring.</scene_description>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>Yeah, we just got married. He's a surgeon. He fixes smiles.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Diana hears some whispered GIGGLING. Turns to catch two counter girls quietly mocking her appearance. She pretends to not notice. AUNTIE ANNE'S PRETZELS Diana has another pretzel in her mouth. Talks through an even larger quantity of dough to the same cashier.</scene_description>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>Another crash. It's picking up. Is that a free sample? Is that onion?</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>(chokes, then clears)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Mmm. There's a nice tang to that.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>SPORTING GOODS STORE Diana looks at a monitor showing footage for something called FAMILY FUN PACKAGE. A happy family is whitewater rafting.</scene_description>
    <character>SPORTING GOODS SALESMAN</character>
    <dialogue>So how old are your kids?</dialogue>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>15, 12, 10, 8 and 6. Jaden, Cathy, Sam, JP and Anna.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>She eyes the large yellow inflatable on display.</scene_description>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>Huh. I could buy raft...</dialogue>
    <scene_description>BROOKSTONE Diana VIBRATES in a massage chair. Asleep. Drooling. An employee nudges her. She wakes spastically.</scene_description>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>What the fuck?</dialogue>
    <character>BROOKSTONE EMPLOYEE</character>
    <dialogue>Ma'am? Your card and your receipt?</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Oh. She gets her bearings. Checks the receipt. One massage chair plus home delivery. $1,899.99. Diana does some math in her head, then hands the card back to the salesman.</scene_description>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>Keep it. It's done.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>The salesman takes the card back, confused. Diana turns over on the massage chair so that's she face down. Still vibrating.</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>INT. SANDY'S CAR - SAME TIME</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>A Yaris. Sandy drives, cell phone to his ear. It's ringing. BOOP. He checks his phone. TRISH (HOME) - CALL FAILED. The LOW GAS alert pings on the dashboard.</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. GAS STATION - EVENING</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Sandy's redialing Trish as he swipes his card at the pump. Boop. Dropped call. Again. The pump says DECLINED - SEE MANAGER. Huh?</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>INT. GAS STATION - MOMENTS LATER</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>The attendant, ARUN, sits in his glassed-in cashier booth, talking loudly in HINDI on his BLUETOOTH earpiece.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Excuse me? Something's wrong with pump 5. It's not taking my card.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Sandy passes it through the tray. Arun takes it, swipes it...</scene_description>
    <character>ARUN</character>
    <dialogue>Oh, look at this, buddy!</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Arun holds up the scanner. It says INVLD. - DESTROY CARD.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>What? Why would it say that?</dialogue>
    <character>ARUN</character>
    <dialogue>Because you don't pay your fucking bills, deadbeat!</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>I absolutely pay my bills! And you can't talk to customers like that!</dialogue>
    <character>ARUN</character>
    <dialogue>Yes I can. Bulletproof glass. Suck my balls.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Arun starts talking in Hindi on his bluetooth. Laughs.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Who is that? Who are you talking to?</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Arun turns a WEBCAM toward Sandy's credit card.</scene_description>
    <character>ARUN</character>
    <dialogue>My family in Mumbai. They're watching me cut up your card. I'm slingboxing this shit to them.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Do not cut that card up!</dialogue>

    <character>ARUN</character>
    <dialogue>Ha ha! You like this song? The chorus means "fuck you".</dialogue>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>INT. SANDY'S CAR - MOMENTS LATER</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Sandy drives, fuming. Phone to his ear. It's ringing.</scene_description>
    <character>LORETTA (ON PHONE)</character>
    <dialogue>Hello, this is Loretta with MobiCom. With whom am I speaking?</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Sandy Patterson.</dialogue>
    <character>LORETTA (ON PHONE)</character>
    <dialogue>And can I have the last four of your social?</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>LORETTA (ON PHONE)</dialogue>
    <scene_description>And how may I assist you this evening?</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>I can't seem to make any calls.</dialogue>
    <character>LORETTA (ON PHONE)</character>
    <dialogue>Yes, I see we've suspended your service for an overdue balance of $369.73.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>No, that's a mistake. I pay this bill regularly.</dialogue>
    <character>LORETTA (ON PHONE)</character>
    <dialogue>I'm sorry, sir. If you'd like to pay by phone right now, we can restore service to all three of your numbers.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Three? What three? I have two numbers. My wife and myself.</dialogue>
    <character>LORETTA (ON PHONE)</character>
    <dialogue>I'm showing a third line, added two months ago. Area code 305-697--</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>305? Where is that?</dialogue>
    <character>LORETTA (ON PHONE)</character>
    <dialogue>Homestead, Florida.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Homestead. Where that salon was? And then: Whoooo! Flashing sirens behind him.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Shit.</dialogue>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. SANDY'S CAR - MOMENTS LATER</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Sandy's pulled over. The COP approaches his window.</scene_description>
    <character>COP</character>
    <dialogue>We have a hands-free phone law, sir. License and registration.</dialogue>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. SANDY'S CAR - MOMENTS LATER</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>The cop walks back over. Hand on the butt of his gun.</scene_description>
    <character>COP</character>
    <dialogue>Step out of the car, Mr. Patterson.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <parenthetical>(gets out)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Really? Okay. Didn't realize it was that big of a-- OW!</dialogue>
    <scene_description>The cop SPINS HIM AROUND. SLAMS HIM against the hood of his car. Arm bent behind his back.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>INT. BOSTON POLICE STATION - INTERVIEW ROOM - EVENING</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Sandy sits alone. Handcuffed. Shell-shocked. Two DETECTIVES enter. Close the door behind them. The lead detective is REILLY, 40's. Moustache. Men's Wearhouse.</scene_description>
    <character>DET. REILLY</character>
    <dialogue>Mr. Patterson, I'm Detective Reilly.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Listen, there's been a mistake.</dialogue>
    <character>DET. REILLY</character>
    <dialogue>There's no mistake. The arresting officer ran your license through the NCIC. You were booked for felony assault two weeks ago in Florida.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Florida? Wait-- was it Homestead?</dialogue>
    <character>DET. REILLY</character>
    <dialogue>Oh good, so we're dropping the whole "there's been a mistake". You missed your court date this morning. Judge issued a warrant, we ship you down there tomorrow. Enjoy the weather.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Waitwaitwait. Listen. Please! Someone with my name is doing these things. Making salon appointments, opening phone accounts--</dialogue>
    <character>DET. REILLY</character>
    <dialogue>Are you or are you not Sandy Bigelow Patterson, born May 18th, 1973?</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>I am, but-- I swear! This is someone else. It's not me.</dialogue>
    <character>DET. REILLY</character>
    <parenthetical>(beat, then to his partner)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Call Homestead PD. Pull the mugshot.</dialogue>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>INT. INTERVIEW ROOM - LATER</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Reilly's partner walks back in the room. Hands Reilly a folder. Reilly opens it. Examines what's inside.</scene_description>
    <character>DET. REILLY</character>
    <dialogue>Woof. Uncuff him.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>The partner removes Sandy's cuffs. Reilly takes a document from the folder, puts it on the table. Turns it toward Sandy. It's the MUGSHOT of DIANA. Holding a name card and birthdate. Sandy Bigelow Patterson. 5-18-73.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Who the hell is this?</dialogue>
    <character>DET. REILLY</character>
    <dialogue>If I had to guess, I'd say it's the woman who stole your identity. Obviously taking advantage of the fact that you have a girly name.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>It's not girly. It's unisex. So what is this-- like credit card fraud?</dialogue>
    <character>DET. REILLY</character>
    <dialogue>No, it's worse than that. They get a hold of your name, birth date, social security-- then they run up debt, get arrested, commit crimes-- as you. They tunnel into your life like a termite and rot you out from the inside until there's nothing left.</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>(claps his hands)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Anyhoo, you'll fill out some forms, we'll put a top level fraud alert out, that's about that.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>What? No, you have to stop her! You have to go get this woman!</dialogue>
    <character>DET. REILLY</character>
    <dialogue>We don't "go get" anyone. We're Boston PD. All we do is open and close the case. If she buys something on Amazon, Seattle PD investigates. Your mobile company's in Connecticut? Hartford PD handles that. And so on and so forth for every single theft.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>How long does that take?</dialogue>
    <character>DET. REILLY</character>
    <dialogue>Six months to a year.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>A YEAR?</scene_description>
    <character>DET. REILLY</character>
    <dialogue>Yeah, let me explain our priorities.</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>(gestures with his hand)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>See, up here, we got our murders and rapes.</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>(sweeps from high to low)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Then allllllll this is the stupid shit people do when they're drunk or in love.</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>(low to the ground)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Down here is identity theft.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>So I'm on the bottom.</dialogue>
    <character>DET. REILLY</character>
    <dialogue>Well, below that's marijuana, cuz you know, fuck it. Everybody gets high.</dialogue>
    <character>DET. REILLY</character>
    <parenthetical>(rises)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>That's all. You're free to go. Take that mugshot with you. Might help you with the credit card companies.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Jesus.</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>(writes on a pad)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>This is my new work contact info. Call me if you hear anything.</dialogue>
    <character>DET. REILLY</character>
    <dialogue>I'll do that. In six months to a year.</dialogue>

  <scene>

    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>There's nothing to worry about.</dialogue>
    <character>TRISH</character>
    <dialogue>Okay.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Just gonna pull up the credit card-- WHAT? Look at this! Jewelry? A massage chair? We don't have a pot to piss in, she's buying massage chairs?</dialogue>
    <character>TRISH</character>
    <dialogue>Sandy.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Hold on. I'm checking our credit rating.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>The TRW screen says 205. Sandy reels. Then recovers.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Okay, no problem. We'll start with the First Boston Visa.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>They're a big bank, we're good customers, they'll get it.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>TEN MINUTES LATER - Sandy's on the phone, pacing. Trish watches, her panic mounting by the second.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>What do you mean you don't believe me? I have a police report! No, not for the jewelry or the massage chair, I just found out about that! Prove? How I do prove I didn't buy something? My identity was stolen! Oh, I'm a liar now? You're calling me a LIAR? You know what? THIS IS WHY EVERYONE HATES BANKS! Get your manager!</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>(beat)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Hello? Hello?</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>(tosses the phone)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>GodDAMMIT!</dialogue>

    <character>TRISH</character>
    <dialogue>Sandy.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>What.</dialogue>
    <character>TRISH</character>
    <dialogue>You quit your job.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>He registers her absolute panic. Moves into calming mode.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Okay, babe, listen. The new job is a great thing. I swear to you. This is going to get us out of here, into a house, a new life--</dialogue>
    <character>TRISH</character>
    <dialogue>We don't have credit cards. We don't have cell phones.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>I'll ask Bryan for an advance tomorrow.</dialogue>
    <character>TRISH</character>
    <dialogue>We need a new crib and diapers and--</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Trish, Trish, honey. I have it under control.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Trish takes a breath. Then puts a hand on his. Nods.</scene_description>
    <character>JESSIE</character>
    <dialogue>Daddy? The TV's broken.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Sandy looks up at the TV. The screen says: ERROR 713b: Your service has been disrupted due to an outstanding balance. Sandy leans back in his chair. This is not under control.</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. OFFICE BUILDING - BOSTON - MORNING</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Another high-rise in the business district.</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>INT. NEW CENTURY FINANCIAL - OFFICES - CONTINUOUS</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>The elevator dings. Sandy steps out into THE NEW OFFICES. Workers install new computers, move in furniture, etc. Sandy sees Bryan in the CONFERENCE ROOM.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Bryan, can I talk to you for a second?</dialogue>
    <character>BRYAN</character>
    <dialogue>Just a sec. I want you to meet Dave Weiss. He heads up the endowment at Boston University.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Sandy shakes hands with DAVE WEISS, 50's.</scene_description>
    <character>BRYAN</character>
    <dialogue>Sandy's our back office whiz. Handles legal, accounts, every single transaction. He's amazing.</dialogue>
    <character>DAVE WEISS</character>
    <dialogue>Good to hear. We're putting nearly a billion dollars on your desk.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>I'll make sure to take great care of you, sir. Umm, Bryan, if I could just grab one quick--</dialogue>
    <character>DET. REILLY (O.S.)</character>
    <dialogue>Mr. Patterson!</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Sandy, Bryan and Weiss turn to see: DETECTIVE REILLY and two uniformed cops emerging from the elevator. Sandy quickly turns to Bryan.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>It's okay. My identity was stolen. It's a huge mess.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Reilly and Sandy shake hands.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>So-- you have some news?</dialogue>
    <character>DET. REILLY</character>
    <dialogue>Indeed I do. You're under investigation for narcotics trafficking.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Wait-- what??? Bryan and the client stare in shock.</scene_description>
    <character>DET. REILLY</character>
    <dialogue>We have a warrant to search the premises. Cuff him.</dialogue>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>INT. CONFERENCE ROOM - LATER</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Sandy sits alone. The FLAT SCREEN TV is on, the sound muted. REILLY enters with Bryan and one of the cops.</scene_description>
    <character>DET. REILLY</character>
    <dialogue>Okay, uncuff him.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>You mind explaining what's going on?</dialogue>
    <character>DET. REILLY</character>
    <dialogue>Chicago PD busted an oxycontin ring last night. Your name and address were on a list of buyers.</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>(off Sandy's reaction)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>I'm not an idiot, Mr. Patterson. I know there's a halfway decent chance it's your friend in Florida. Which means there's a halfway decent chance it's not. Until I can prove you didn't do this, it's an open investigation.</dialogue>
    <character>BRYAN</character>
    <dialogue>For narcotics. Sandy, I'm sorry, but--</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Bryan-- please don't do this. I can't go back to Cornish, he's blackballing me everywhere else--</dialogue>
    <character>BRYAN</character>
    <dialogue>We almost lost BU over this. We're asking people to entrust you with their information! Account codes, balances, access to funds--</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>I am unemployable right now, Brian! I have no money, no credit--</dialogue>
    <character>BRYAN</character>
    <dialogue>You can't. Not with this over your head. You CAN'T WORK HERE! That's it.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Sandy puts his head in his hands.</scene_description>
    <character>DET. REILLY</character>
    <dialogue>For what it's worth, I am sorry.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Sandy doesn't move. Bryan walks Reilly out. Finally, Sandy lifts his head. Alone. Just him and the silent TV. An ad. A woman massages shampoo into her scalp. Holy shit.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>LADY'S CHOICE!</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Bryan and Reilly turn back to him.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>What if I knew where she was? I find her, and I turn her over to the police? Would you clear my name?</dialogue>
    <character>DET. REILLY</character>
    <dialogue>They'd put her up on Florida charges first. It'd be a year before we'd get a crack at her. She'd have to be standing right here to do you any good.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>That's the new standard for police work? The criminal has to STAND RIGHT IN FRONT OF YOU?</dialogue>
    <character>DET. REILLY</character>
    <dialogue>You have a good day.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Wait!</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>(point of no return)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>What if I brought her to you?</dialogue>
    <character>DET. REILLY</character>
    <dialogue>C'mon, Mr. Patterson.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>If I bring her to you and she gives a full statement-- owns up to everything-- will you clear my name?</dialogue>
    <character>DET. REILLY</character>
    <dialogue>If all that happens. Yeah. Sure.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Reilly EXITS.</scene_description>
    <character>BRYAN</character>
    <dialogue>Sandy, I'm sorry, but we don't have time. Accounts are rolling in, you can't clear a background check-- I need someone doing the work now.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Bryan, I have a family. I stood up for you. Please.</dialogue>
    <character>BRYAN</character>
    <parenthetical>(beat, then)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>I'll give you five days.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <parenthetical>(already running out)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Thank you!</dialogue>
    <character>BRYAN</character>
    <dialogue>Five days! That's all I can do!</dialogue>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>INT. SANDY'S APARTMENT - LATER</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Sandy packs a SUITCASE while he's on the phone. Trish watches.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Yes, this is Sandy Patterson, you called the other day? I want to confirm that appointment. It was for my wife, she's gonna be in the area, I didn't realize. Tomorrow at three, right? And your address again?</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>(scribbles it down)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Great, got it. She'll be there.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>He hangs up.</scene_description>
    <character>TRISH</character>
    <dialogue>This is insane.</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>(holds up handcuffs)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Where did you even get these?</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>You know. That place. Oh, and I borrowed your anxiety pills. In case I have to coax her on to the plane.</dialogue>
    <character>TRISH</character>
    <dialogue>No, that's fine. Cause WHY WOULD I NEED THOSE RIGHT NOW?!</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Shhh shhh shhh. I'm gonna fly out, get her, fly back, and we're done.</dialogue>
    <character>JESSIE</character>
    <dialogue>Daddy? Are you going on a trip?</dialogue>
    <scene_description>The girls stand in the door. He kneels down and hugs them.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>I am. I'm going to pretty much the worst place in America-- but when I come back, I'm going to be a better daddy. And we're going to live in a big house with a yard and presents and braces and weddings. Okay?</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>(kisses them both)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Okay, go on. Be good!</dialogue>
    <scene_description>They run out. Trish folds her arms, a nervous wreck.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>I paid the mobile bill. Our phones are back on, I'll call you every step of the way.</dialogue>
    <character>TRISH</character>
    <dialogue>I don't like this. It's dangerous.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>It's one woman. She's five foot nothing. She's a hobbit.</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>(kisses her)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>I won't let you down.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>She frowns, then softens. Kisses him back.</scene_description>
    <character>TRISH</character>
    <dialogue>You never do. Go get the bitch.</dialogue>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. MIAMI INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT - NEXT MORNING</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>The BOS-MIA flight comes in for a landing...</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. FLORIDA TURNPIKE - LATER</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Sandy drives a rented CHEVY COBALT toward HOMESTEAD</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. STRIP MALL - HOMESTEAD, FLORIDA - 3 PM</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>A depressed, far distant suburb of Miami. SANDY - sits in his car, windows down. Sweating. Looking at: LADY'S CHOICE SALON - tacky, tacky, tacky. A large sign on the window says TAN HAIR. Sandy checks his watch. Five past noon. And then-- a new NISSAN pulls into the lot. Sticker in the window. DIANA gets out of the car. Walks into Lady's Choice. Sandy sits back. He's got her.</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. STRIP MALL - HOMESTEAD, FLORIDA - LATER</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Diana emerges. Her bad hair is still bad, but blacker and bigger. Nails are bright pink. Jesus. What a look.</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>I/E. DIANA'S CAR/ SANDY'S CAR - MOMENTS LATER</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>SANDY follows her, keeping an appropriate distance. DIANA glances at her rearview mirror. Sees the Cobalt following her. Hmmm. She accelerates. SANDY speeds up as well. Doesn't want to lose her. They approach an ELEVATED CAUSEWAY over marshy SWAMP. The only two cars visible for miles. DIANA accelerates more. SANDY keeps up. Until-- SCREEEE! Diana SLAMS ON HER BRAKES.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Shit!</dialogue>
    <scene_description>He slams on HIS BRAKES-- SKIDS-- and-- CRUNCH-- he rear-ends her at about 15 mph. Not even enough to pop the airbags.</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. CAUSEWAY - CONTINUOUS</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Sandy gets out of his car. Sees Diana slowly get out of hers. She's holding her neck.</scene_description>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>Ugh. My neck! Son of a bitch!</dialogue>
    <scene_description>He can't believe it. She's pulling a scam.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>I'm sorry. You stopped so short.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>He walks around her car, surveying the damage. Subtly placing himself between her and her driver's side door.</scene_description>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>There was a gopher in the road. OW, my spine!</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>You know what? This is totally my fault. Let's exchange information. My insurance will cover everything.</dialogue>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>All right. Yeah. Cool. Here.</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>(hands him her license)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Or maybe we could just do cash. Save you a little on your rates.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>You would do that for me?</dialogue>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>I would. I'm a good person. You know? Like, what would Jesus do?</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Jesus doesn't have insurance?</dialogue>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>No, he's god. What's wrong with you?</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <parenthetical>(reads her license)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Sandy Bigelow Patterson. Bigelow. You don't hear that too often.</dialogue>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>It's a family name. Mother's side. Goes back to the Mayflower. Jeremiah Bigelow. He was a bear hunter.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Huh. Interesting. Here's my license.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>She takes it. Looks at it. Sandy Bigelow Patterson. She slowly removes her hand from her neck. Straightens her posture. Looks back at Sandy like she's a different person. Then she PUNCHES him in the THROAT. Sandy drops like a dead man, still conscious, but gagging on his own throat. She tries to push past him into her car, but he BLOCKS HER ACCESS to the door while he tries to breathe. She runs and gets into HIS car. Starts it up. Backs up. Watching this, gasping for air, Sandy gets into HER car. Turns the key, but the engine won't turn over. Then: WHAM! He lurches forward into the steering wheel. Looks back. She's rammed HIS car into HER car. And now she's PUSHING her car, with him in it. To the edge of the causeway. He pushes the brake to the floor. HONKS the horn.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Hey! HEY!!!</dialogue>
    <scene_description>But she's not stopping. And he's almost to the edge... it's a good thirty foot drop... Sandy flings the car door open and JUMPS OUT just before-- DIANA PUSHES HER OWN CAR OFF THE CAUSEWAY - it goes END over END over END and lands with a SPLASH in the SWAMPY MUCK. Sandy turns back and sees her GIVE HIM THE FINGER as she peels off in his rental. Stranding him. His phone rings. He answers, still finding his voice.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Hello?</dialogue>
    <character>TRISH (ON PHONE)</character>
    <dialogue>Hey babe, it's me. Just checking in to see how things were going.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>He peers over the edge at Diana's car. Restrains his own panic.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Yeah. Off to a little bit of a slow start. Caught my ankle on the first hurdle there. Nothing to worry about. I'll call you in a few.</dialogue>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>INT. SANDY'S APARTMENT - CONTINUOUS</stage_direction>
    <character>TRISH</character>
    <dialogue>Okay. Be careful. I love you.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>She hangs up. The phone immediately rings back. She answers.</scene_description>
    <character>TRISH</character>
    <dialogue>Sandy?</dialogue>
    <character>DEBT COLLECTOR (ON PHONE)</character>
    <dialogue>No, this is Dan from Superior Debt Collection. Can we speak to Sandy?</dialogue>
    <character>TRISH</character>
    <dialogue>He's not here right now. I'm his wife. Is there something I can--</dialogue>
    <character>DEBT COLLECTOR (ON PHONE)</character>
    <dialogue>Where is he?</dialogue>
    <character>TRISH</character>
    <dialogue>He's in Florida, but--</dialogue>
    <character>DEBT COLLECTOR (ON PHONE)</character>
    <dialogue>Florida? Where in Florida?</dialogue>
    <character>TRISH</character>
    <dialogue>I don't know exactly...</dialogue>
    <character>DEBT COLLECTOR (ON PHONE)</character>
    <dialogue>You're saying he left town and you don't know where he is?</dialogue>
    <character>TRISH</character>
    <dialogue>Yes, but--</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Click. Dial tone. Trish looks at the phone. What just happened?</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. BENEATH THE CAUSEWAY - DAY</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Sandy slowly makes his way down the embankment into the marsh below the road. His shoes SINK into the reeking muck. Ugh. DIANA'S CAR - is half submerged in the swamp. Sandy opens the exposed passenger door. Crawls into her car. Opens the glove compartment. Nothing but the manual. Looks around. Sees: PINK PAPER wedged in the rear seat. He pulls it out. It's a BILL OF SALE for the car. Made out to Sandy Patterson. Goddammit. But below that... ...a Homestead, FL address.</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. DIANA'S HOUSE - UGLY DEVELOPMENT - LATER</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Prefab homes. Tiny lots. SANDY gets out of a cab. Walks toward DIANA'S HOUSE. The RENTAL CAR is in the driveway. And there's a goddamn MOTORBOAT parked on the lawn. DIANA - emerges from her house with a SUITCASE. Sees him. She drops the suitcase and RUNS back to the house. He CHASES, and just as she SLAMS THE DOOR, he jams an LEG in.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>AGGH!</dialogue>
    <scene_description>He pushes in after her, and she backs away over piles of: STUFF. The house is a HOARDER'S PARADISE. Piles and piles of electronics, housewares, clothing, sporting goods, cameras, musical instruments, bulk food items... most of it UNTOUCHED. The MASSAGE CHAIR is in the corner. And the big yellow RAFT.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Wow. Been shopping, Sandy?</dialogue>
    <scene_description>He pulls the HANDCUFFS out of his jacket pocket, starts walking toward her. He will not be denied.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Here's the deal. We can do this the easy way, or the--</dialogue>
    <scene_description>She PUNCHES HIM IN THE THROAT. Again. He goes down. She tries to jump over him, but he GRABS HER LEG. She goes down, and they FIGHT. A SLOPPY, MESSY fight between two desperate people, neither of whom can afford to lose. He tries to HANDCUFF HER, but he can't pin her down. She rolls over him, smothering his face in her tits.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <parenthetical>(muffled)</parenthetical>
    <character>GARRR! GARRBARAARRRRR!!!!!</character>
    <dialogue>She's got her hand JAMMED in his pocket. CLENCHING. He roars in pain, wriggles free... and she BITES HIM on the leg.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>AGHHHH!!!</dialogue>
    <scene_description>He starts PUNCHING HER on the back of her head until her jaws RELEASE. They ROLL OVER, and now he's on top of her. Face to face. Sweaty. Her makeup is SMEARED. Breathing into each other's mouths. Close enough to kiss.</scene_description>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>Huh. Where's this going?</dialogue>
    <scene_description>He backs away, and she KNEES him in the chest, then bolts for the front door. Sandy grabs the RAFT OAR and FLINGS IT AT HER. It hits her in the back of the head, and she GOES DOWN. He staggers past her. Shuts the front door. Deadbolts it. Diana struggles to her feet, dazed. Holding the back of her head in pain. She flops down on her couch, winded. Sandy sees an overturned SHOE BOX on the floor. Spilling out of it are DRIVER'S LICENSES. All with Diana's picture. All different states. All different names. He grabs a handful.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>What is wrong with you? You're sick! Look at all this stuff. You don't even need it!</dialogue>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>Oh, you know me now?</dialogue>
    <scene_description>He sees FOUR GUITARS. He lifts one up.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Oh, okay. You play? I'd love to hear something. Or are these for your husband? No? Boyfriend?</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>(tosses the guitar)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Well there's a shock.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>That same flash of pain crosses her face. Sandy catches it. And even though she's ruined his life, he gets a guilty twinge. He was cruel, and he knows it.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>What's your name?</dialogue>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>Julie.</dialogue>
    <character>AVI (O.S.)</character>
    <dialogue>DIANA!!!</dialogue>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>Shit!</dialogue>
    <scene_description>A POUNDING on the door. INTERCUT WITH: AVI AND ILAN, 20's, Israeli, wearing honest- to-god Jordache jeans (still sold at Walmart!) and windbreakers. Total thugs. Hebrew accents.</scene_description>
    <character>AVI</character>
    <dialogue>Diana, open the fucking door!</dialogue>
    <scene_description>BACK INSIDE - Diana makes a "SHUT UP" face to Sandy.</scene_description>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>What's the problem, Avi?</dialogue>
    <character>AVI (O.S.)</character>
    <dialogue>The problem is you fuck Moshe! He bail you out, you trade him shit ID?</dialogue>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>It's not shit! It's good!</dialogue>
    <character>AVI (O.S.)</character>
    <dialogue>It doesn't work! He lost twenty grand on this oxycontin deal! Open the door! We just want to talk!</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Diana grabs a KNAPSACK. Starts throwing stuff in. Makeup, blank MAGSTRIP CARDS, a small keypad device, hairspray...</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>What are you doing? Who is that?</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Diana moves into her BEDROOM. She quickly takes down a POSTER from her wall, blocking our view of it. She carefully folds it and puts it in her KNAPSACK.</scene_description>
    <character>AVI (O.S.)</character>
    <dialogue>Diana, don't make me break this door!</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Diana moves back into the living room, looks for: THE JINGLE OF KEYS - Sandy is holding the car keys.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Looking for someth--</dialogue>
    <scene_description>KABOOM! A SHOTGUN BLAST blows through the WINDOW.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Jesus!</dialogue>
    <scene_description>KABOOM! Another blast. Diana grabs a STEAK KNIFE and starts RUNNING. Sandy runs after her, scared out of his mind...</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. DIANA'S HOUSE - CONTINUOUS</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Avi KICKS the front door in just in time to NOT SEE Diana and Sandy running out the OTHER side of the house. Diana SLASHES two tires on Avi's car with the knife, throws her knapsack into the RENTAL, and she and Sandy get in.</scene_description>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>GO GO GO!</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Sandy starts the car and PEELS OUT. Avi and Ilan realize their mistake and run back outside, but the Cobalt is already driving away, and Avi's car is LEANING on two flat tires.</scene_description>
    <character>AVI</character>
    <dialogue>YOR PIN NOTEPH ZIVA!!!!!</dialogue>
    <scene_description>He kicks his car. Fury in his eyes. We don't know Hebrew, but we can tell they just fucked with the wrong Israeli.</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>INT. RENTAL CAR - ON THE HIGHWAY - LATER</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Sandy and Diana drive in silence. Both PISSED. Finally...</scene_description>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>Just let me off at the next exit.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>I don't think so. And I think you meant to say "sorry for getting you SHOT AT."</dialogue>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>I'm not sorry for that. Pull over.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>No. We're getting on a plane, Diana, and we're flying to Boston.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Diana laughs in his face. Then:</scene_description>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>Seriously, pull over or I'll kick your ass in again.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Look. How about we find a bar-- I'll buy you a drink and explain the whole thing. Okay?</dialogue>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>A drink? Sure. That's a perfect way to dose me with your wife's Xanax.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>She lifts the pill bottle up. Rattles it. He checks his pants pocket. She picked his fucking pocket during the fight...</scene_description>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>Now PULL OVER.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Fine! Is that what you want?!</dialogue>
    <scene_description>He PULLS THE CAR OVER to the side of the road.</scene_description>
  </scene>
  <scene>
    <stage_direction>EXT. HIGHWAY SHOULDER - DAY</stage_direction>
    <scene_description>Diana gets out. Starts walking. Sandy gets out. Starts dialing his cell phone. Yelling after her over the traffic noise.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>I'll just let 911 know a criminal with a known warrant is walking around on the highway. I've got lots of evidence they'd love to see!</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>(she keeps walking)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>I have your home address, your photo, a handful of your fake licenses in my pocket...</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>(she keeps walking)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>And once you're in jail, "Avi" will know exactly where to find you.</dialogue>
    <scene_description>Diana stops.</scene_description>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <parenthetical>(mutters to herself)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Mother fucker...</dialogue>
    <parenthetical>(turns back to him)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>You want me dead?</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>I want you in Boston.</dialogue>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <dialogue>Why?</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>I need you to tell my boss I didn't sell oxycontin or rack up debt or any of this stuff.</dialogue>
    <character>DIANA</character>
    <parenthetical>(sneers)</parenthetical>
    <dialogue>Oh. For a job. You and your anxious wife gotta maintain your lifestyle, right? I bet Trish is real pretty.</dialogue>
    <character>SANDY</character>

    <scene_description>You can hear a pin drop. Diana stares in shock. The librarian stares in shock.</scene_description>
    <character>SANDY</character>
    <dialogue>Now. Tell me. Do I still sound like this "Sandy Patterson"?</dialogue>
    <character>CORNISH</character>
    <parenthetical>(shaken)</parenthetical>
